text.body:
aitareya āraṇyakam
bhūmimupaspṛśedagna ilā nama ilā nama ṛṣibhyo mantrakṛdbhyo mantrapatibhyo namo vo astu devebhyaḥ śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhava sumṛlīkā sarasvati mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi || bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ |
sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitu yadāyuḥ || śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhirgīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā rātahavyā | śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau || stuṣe janaṃ suvrataṃ navyasībhirgīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā sumnayantā | ta āgamantu ta iha śruvantu sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniḥ || kayā naścitra ābhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā || kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ | dṛhlācidāruje vasu || abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām | śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ || syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ || oṣṭhāpidhānā nakulī dantaiḥ parivṛtā paviḥ | sarvasyai vāca īśānā cārumāmiha vādayediti vāgrasaḥ || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ |
|| atha prathamāraṇyakam ||
<1.1.1>
om || atha mahāvratam | indro vai vṛtraṃ hatvā mahānabhavadyanmahānabhavattanmahāvratamabhavattanmahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | dve etasyāhna ājye kuryāditi haika āhurekamiti tveva sthitam| pra vo devāyāgnaya iti rāddhikāmaḥ | viśo viśo vo atithimiti puṣṭikāmaḥ | puṣṭirvai viśaḥ puṣṭimānbhavatīti| atithimiti padaṃ bhavati naitatkuryādityāhurīśvaro'tithireva caritoḥ | tadu ha smāha kuryādeva | yo vai bhavati yaḥ śreṣṭhatāmaśnute sa vā ati thirbhavati | na vā asantamātithyāyādriyante | tasmādu kāmamevaitakuryāt | sa yadyetatkuryādāganma vṛtrahantamamityetaṃ tṛcaṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt | etadvā aharīpsantaḥ saṃvatsaramāsate ta āgachanti | ta ete'nuṣṭupśīrṣāṇastrayastṛcā bhavanti brahma vai gāyatrī vāganuṣṭubbrahmaṇaiva tadvācaṃ saṃdadhāti | abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāmiti kīrtikāmaḥ | hotājaniṣṭa cetana iti prajāpaśu kāmaḥ || 1.1.1 ||
<1.1.2>
agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraraṇyorityannādyakāmaḥ | agnirvā annādaḥ | cirataramiva vā itareṣvājyeṣyagnimāgachantyatheha mukhata evāgnimāgachanti mukhato'nnādyamaśnute mukhataḥ pāpmānamapaghnate | hastacyutī janayanteti jātavadetasmādvā ahno yajamāno jāyate tasmājjātavat | tāni catvāri chandāṃsi bhavanti catuṣpādā vai paśavaḥ paśūnāmavaruddhyai | tāni trīṇi chandāṃsi bhavanti trayo vā ime trivṛto lokā eṣāmeva lokānāmabhijityai | te dve chandasī bhavataḥ pratiṣṭhāyā eva | dvipratiṣṭho vai puruṣaścatuṣpādāḥ paśavo yajamānameva taddvipratiṣṭhaṃ catuṣpātsu paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati | tāḥ parāgvacanena pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti pañcaviṃśo'yaṃ puruṣo daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa pādyā dvā ūrū dvau bāhū ātmaiva pañcaviṃśastamimamātmānaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ saṃskurute | atho pañcaviṃśaṃ vā etadahaḥ pañcaviṃśa etasyāhna stomastatsamena samaṃ pratipadyate tasmāddve eva pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti | tāstriḥ prathamayā triruttamayaikayā na triṃśannyūnākṣarā virāṭ | nyūne vai retaḥ sicyate nyūne prāṇā nyūne'nnādyaṃ pratiṣṭhitameteṣāṃ kāmānāmavaruddhyai | etānkāmānavarundhe ya evaṃ veda | tā abhisaṃpadyante bṛhatīṃ ca virājaṃ ca chando yaitasyāhnaḥ saṃpattāmatho anuṣṭubhamanuṣṭubāyatanāni hyājyāni ||1.1.2||
<1.1.3>
gāyatraṃ praugaṃ kuryādityāhustejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavatīti | auṣṇiha praugaṃ kuryādityāhurāyurvā uṣṇigāyuṣmānbhavatīti | ānuṣṭubhaṃ praugaṃ kuryādityāhuḥ kṣattraṃ vā anuṣṭupkṣattrasyā''ptyā iti bārhataṃ praugaṃ kuryādityāhuḥ śrīrvai bṛhatī śrīmānbhavatīti pāṅktaṃ praugaṃ kuyādityāhurannaṃ vai paṅktirannavānbhavatīti traiṣṭubhaṃ praugaṃ kuryādityāhurvīryaṃ vai triṣṭubvīryavānbhavatīti jāgataṃ praugaṃ kuryādityāhurjāgatā vai paśavaḥ paśumānbhavatīti, iti | tadu gāyatrameva kuryādbrahma vai gāyatrī brahme tadaharbrahmaṇaiva tadbrahma pratipadyate, iti | tadu mādhucchandasam, iti | madhu ha sma vā ṛṣibhyo madhucchandāśchandati tanmadhucchandaso madhucchandastvam, iti | atho annaṃ vai madhu sarvaṃ vai madhu sarve vai kāmā madhu tadyanmādhucchandasaṃ śaṃsati sarveṣāṃ kāmānāmavaruddhyai, iti | sarvānkāmānavarundhe ya evaṃ veda, iti | tadvaikāhikaṃ rūpasamṛddhaṃ bahu vā etasminnahani kiṃca kiṃca vāraṇaṃ kriyate śāntyā eva śāntirvai pratiṣṭhaikāhaḥ śāntyāmeva tatpratiṣṭhāyāmantataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti, iti | pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake prathamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1.1.3 ||
<1.1.4>
vāyavāyāhi darśateme somā araṃ kṛtā ityetadvā ahararaṃ yajamānāya ca devebhyaśca, iti | araṃ hāsmā etadaharbhavati ya evaṃ veda yeṣā caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | indravāyū ime sutā āyātamupaniṣkṛtamiti yadvai niṣkṛtaṃ tatsaṃskṛtam, iti | ā hāsyendravāyū saṃskṛtaṃ gacchato ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhanteti vāgvai dhīrghṛtācī iti | vācamevāsmiṃstaddadhāti ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | aśvinā yajvarīriṣa ityannaṃ vā iṣo'nnādyasyāvaruddhayai, iti | āyātaṃ rudravartanī iti, iti | ā hāsyāśvinau yajñaṃ gacchato ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati iti | indrā''yāhi citrabhānavindrā''yāhi dhiyeṣita indrā''yāhi tūtujāna ityāyāhyāyāhīti śaṃsati, iti | ā hāsyendro gacchati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa āgateti, iti | ā hāsya viśve devā havaṃ gacchanti ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutamiti yadāha daduṣo daduṣaḥ sutamityeva tadāha, iti | dadati hāsmai taṃ kāmaṃ devā yatkāma etacchaṃsati, iti | ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuriti vāgvai dhiyāvasuḥ, iti | vācamevāsmiṃstaddadhāti ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | yajñaṃ vaṣṭviti yadāha yajñaṃ vahatvityeva tadāha, iti | tāḥ parāgvacanenaikaviṃśatirbhavantyekaviṃśo'yaṃ puruṣo daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa pādyā ātmaikaviṃśastamimamātmānamekaviṃśaṃ saṃskurute, iti | tāstriḥ prathamayā triruttamayā pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti pañcaviṃśa ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ prajāpatirdaśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa pādyā dvā ūrū dvau bāhū ātmaiva pañcaviṃśastamimamātmānaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ saṃskurute'tho pañcaviṃśaṃ vā etadahaḥ pañcaviṃśa etasyāhnaḥ stomastatsamena samaṃ pratipadyate tasmāddve eva pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti bhavanti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1.1.4 || iti bahavṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake prathamā'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<1.2.1>
ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaya idaṃ vaso sutamandha iti marutvatīyasya pratipadanucarau, iti | aikāhikau rūpasamṛddhau bahu vā etasminnahani kiṃca kiṃca vāraṇaṃ kriyate śāntyā eva śāntirvai pratiṣṭhaikāhaḥ śāntyāmeva tatpratiṣṭhāyāmantataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | indra nedīya edihi prasūtirā śacībhirye ta ukthina ityukthaṃ vā etadaharukthavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | praitu brahmaṇaspatiracchā vīramiti vīravadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate suvīryamiti vīryavadrpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyamityukthaṃ vā etadaharukthavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāho rūpam, iti | agnirnetā sa vṛtraheti vārtraghnamindrarūpa maindrametadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukraturbhūstvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhirmahitveti vṛṣaṇvadvā indrasya rūpamaindrametadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | pinvantyapo'tyaṃ na mihe vinayanti vājinamiti vājimadvā indrasya rūpamaindrametadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | atho utsaṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitamiti stanayadvā indrasya rūpamaindrametadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | pra va indrāya bṛhata iti yadvai bṛhattanmahanmahadvadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | bṛhadindrāya gāyateti yadvai bṛhattanmahanmaha dvadrūpasamṛddhametasyāho rūpam, iti | nakiḥ sudāso rathaṃ paryāsa na rīramaditi paryastavadrāntimadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | sarvānpragāthāñcchaṃsati sarveṣāmahnāmāptyai sarveṣāmukthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ praugāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ savanānām, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<1.2.2>
asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivegaḥ satyadhvṛtamiti śaṃsati satyaṃ bā etadahaḥ satyavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | tadu vāsukraṃ brahma vai vasukro brahmaitadaharbrahmaṇaiva tadbrahma pratipadyate, iti | tadāhuratha kasmādvāsrukreṇaitanmarutvatīyaṃ pratipadyata iti na ha vā etadanyo vasukrānmarutvatīyamudayacchanna vivyāceti tasmādvāsukreṇaivaitanmarutvatīyaṃ pratipadyate, iti | tadaniruktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ śaṃsatyanirukto vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpaterāptyai, iti | sakṛdindraṃ nirāha tenaindrādrūpānna pracyavate, iti | pibā somamabhi yamugra tarda iti śaṃsati, iti| ūrvaṃ gavyaṃ mahi gṛṇāna indreti mahadvadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | tadu bhāradvājaṃ bharadvājo ha vā ṛṣīṇāmanūcānatamo dīrghajīvitamastapasvitama āsa sa etena sūktena pāpmānamapāhata tadyadbhāradvājaṃ śaṃsati pāpmano'pahatyā anūcāno dīrghajīvī tapasvyasānīti tasmādbhāradvājaṃ śaṃsati, iti | kayā śubhā savayasaḥ sanīlā iti śaṃsati, iti | āśāsate pratiharyantyukthetyukthaṃ vā etadaharukthavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | tadu kayāśubhīyametadvai saṃjñānaṃ saṃtani sūktaṃ yatkayāśubhīyametena ha vā indro'gastyo marutaste samajānata tadyatkayāśubhīyaṃ śaṃsati saṃjñātyā eva, iti | tadvāyuṣyaṃ tadyo'sya priyaḥ syātkuryādevāsya kayāśubhīyam, iti | marutvām̐ indra vṛṣabho raṇāyeti śaṃsati, iti | indra vṛṣabha iti vṛṣaṇvadvā indrasya rūpamaindrametadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | tadu vaiśvāmitraṃ viśvasya ha vai mitraṃ viśvāmitra āsa, iti | viśvaṃ hāsmai mitraṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāyeti nividdhānamaikāhikaṃ rūpasamṛddhaṃ bahu vā etasminnahani kiṃca kiṃca vāraṇaṃ kriyate śāntyā eva śāntirvai pratiṣṭhaikāhaḥ śāntyāmeva tatpratiṣṭhāyāmantataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | tāḥ parāgvacanena saptanavatirbhavanti sā yā navatistisrastāstriṃśinyo virājo'tha yāḥ saptātiyanti yaivaiṣā praśaṃsā sāptyasya tasyā eva, iti | tāstriḥ prathamayā triruttamayaikaśataṃ bhavanti, iti | pañcāṅgulayaścatuṣparvā dve kakṣasī doścākṣaścāṃsaphalakaṃ ca sā pañcaviṃśatiḥ pañcaviṃśānītarāṇi hyaṅgāni tacchatamātmaikaśatatamaḥ, iti | yacchataṃ tadāyurindriyaṃ vīryaṃ tejo yajamāna ekaśatatama āyuṣīndriye vīrye tejasi pratiṣṭhitaḥ, iti | tāstriṣṭubhamabhi saṃpadyante traiṣṭubho hi madhyaṃdinaḥ, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<1.2.3>
tadāhuḥ kiṃ preṅkhasya preṅkhatvamityayaṃ vai preṅkho yo'yaṃ pavata eṣa hyeṣu lokeṣu preṅkhata iti tatpreṅkhasya preṅkhatvam, iti | ekaṃ phalakaṃ syādityāhurekadhā hyevāyaṃ vāyuḥ pavate'sya rūpeṇeti, iti | tattannā''dṛtyam, iti | trīṇi phalakāni syurityāhustrayo vā ime trivṛto lokā eṣāṃ rūpeṇeti, iti | tattannā''dṛtyam, iti | dve eva syātāṃ dvau vā imau lokāvaddhātamāviva dṛśyete ya u ene antareṇā''kāśaḥ so'ntarikṣalokastasmāddve eva syātām, iti | audumbare syātāmūrgvā annādyamudumbara ūrjo'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai, iti | madhyata uddhṛte syātāṃ madhyato vai prajā annaṃ dhinoti madhyata eva tadannādyasya yajamānaṃ dadhāti, iti | ubhayyo rajjavo bhavanti dakṣiṇāśca savyāśca dakṣiṇā vā ekeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ rajjavaḥ savyā ekeṣāṃ tadyadubhayyo rajjavo bhavantyubhayeṣāṃ paśūnāmāptyai, iti | dārbhyaḥ syurdarbhovā oṣadhīnāmapahatapāpmā tasmāddārbhyaḥ syuḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<1.2.4>
aratnimātra upari bhūmeḥ preṅkhaḥ syādityāhuretāvatā vai svargā lokāḥ saṃmitā iti tattannā''dṛtyam, iti | prādeśamātre syādityāhuretāvatā vai prāṇāḥ saṃmitā iti tattannā''dṛtyam, iti | muṣṭimātre syādetāvatā vai sarvamannādyaṃ kriyata etāvatā sarvamannādyamabhipannaṃ tasmānmuṣṭimātra eva syāt, iti | purastātpratyañca preṅkhamadhirohedityāhuretasya rūpeṇa ya eṣa tapati purastāddhyeṣa imām̐llokānpratyadhirohatīti tattannā''dṛtyam, iti | tiryañcamadhirohedityāhustiryañcaṃ vā aśvamadhirohanti teno sarvānkāmānavāpnavāmeti tattannā''dṛtyam, iti| anvañcamadhirohedityāhuranūcī vai nāvamadhirohanti naurvaiṣā svargayāṇī yatpreṅkha iti tasmādanvañcamevādhirohet, iti | chubukenopaspṛśecchuko haivaṃ vṛkṣamadhirohati sa u vayasāmannādatama iti tasmācchubukenopaspṛśet, iti | bāhubhyāmadhirohedeva śyeno vayāṃsyabhiniviśata evaṃ vṛkṣaṃ sa u vayasāṃ vīryavattama iti tasmādbāhubhyāmadhirohet, iti | asyai pādaṃ nocchindyānnedasyai pratiṣṭhāyā ucchidyā iti, iti | preṅkhaṃ hotā'dhirohatyaudumbarīmāsandīmudgātā vṛṣā vai preṅkho yoṣā''sandī tanmithunaṃ mithunameva tadukthamukhe karoti prajātyai, iti | prajāyate prajayā paśubhirya evaṃ veda, iti | athānnaṃ vai preṅkhaḥ śrīrāsandyannaṃ caiva tacchriyaṃ cānvadhirohataḥ, iti | bṛsīrhotrakāḥ samadhirohanti sabrahmakāḥ, iti | samutsṛpya vā oṣadhivanaspatayaḥ phalaṃ gṛhṇanti tadyadetasminnahani sarvaśaḥ samadhirohantīṣameva tadūrjamannādyamadhirohantyūrjo'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai, iti | vaṣaṭkṛtyāvarohedityāhustattannā''dṛtyamakṛtā vai sā'pacitiryāmapaśyate karoti, iti | nigṛhya bhakṣamavarohedityāhustattannā''dṛtyamakṛtā vai sā'pacitiryāmadhyṛṣṭāya karoti, iti | pratikhyāya bhakṣamavarohedeṣā vā apacitiryāṃ paśyate karoti tasmātpratikhyāyaiva bhakṣamavarohet, iti | prāṅavarohetprāgvai devareta(ḥ?) saṃprajāyate tasmātprāṅavarohedavarohet, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 || iti vahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<1.3.1>
hiṅkāreṇaitadahaḥ pratipadyetetyāhuḥ, iti | brahma vai hiṃkāro brahmaiva tadaharbrahmaṇaiva tadbrahma pratipadyate ya evaṃ veda, iti | yadeva hiṃkāreṇa pratipadyatā3i vṛṣā vai hiṃkāro yoṣarktanmithunaṃ mithunameva tadukthamukhe karoti prajātyai prajāyate prajayā paśubhirya evaṃ veda, iti | yadveva hiṃkāreṇa pratipadyatā3i yathā vā abhrirevaṃ brahmaṇo hiṃkāro yadvai kiṃcābhriyā'bhititṛtsatyabhyevainattṛṇattyevam, iti | yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate hiṃkāreṇābhyevainaṃ tṛṇatti ya evaṃ veda, iti | yadveva hiṃkāreṇa pratipadyatā3i vāco vā eṣā vyāvṛttirdaivyaṃ ca mānuṣye ca yaddhiṃkāraḥ sa yaddhiṃkṛtya pratipadyate vācameva tadvyāvartayati daivīṃ ca mānuṣīṃ ca, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<1.3.2>
tadāhuḥ kaitasyāhnaḥ pratipaditi manaśca vākceti brūyāt, iti | sarve'nyasminkāmāḥ śritāḥ sarvānanyānkāmānduhe, iti | manasi vai sarve kāmāḥ śritā manasā hi sarvānkāmāndhyāyati, iti | sarve hāsminkāmāḥ śrayante ya evaṃ veda, iti | vāgvai sarvānkāmānduhe vācā hi sarvānkāmānvadati, iti | sarvānhāsmai kāmānvāgduhe ya evaṃ veda, iti | tadāhurnaitadaharṛcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā pratyakṣātprati.padyeta narco na yajuṣo na sāmna iyāditi, iti | tadetā vyāhṛtīḥ purastājjapet, iti | bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityetā vāva vyāhṛtaya ime trayo vedā bhūrityeva ṛgvedo bhuva iti yajurvedaḥ svariti sāmavedastannarcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā pratyakṣātpratipadyate narco na yajuṣo na sāmna eti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<1.3.3>
taditi pratipadyate tattaditi vā annamannameva tadabhipratipadyate, iti | etāṃ vāva prajāpatiḥ prathamāṃ vācaṃ vyāharadekākṣaradvyakṣarāṃ tateti tāteti tathaivaitatkumāraḥ prathamavādī vācaṃ vyāharatyekākṣaradvya kṣarāṃ tateti tāteti tayaiva tattatavatyā vācā pratipadyate, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agramityetaddhyeva prathamaṃ vāco agram iti | yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānā iti vācā hi nāmadheyāni dhīyante, iti | yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsīdityetaddhyeva śreṣṭhamaitadaripram, iti | preṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhā''viritadimu ha guhā'dhyātmamimā devatā ada u āviradhidaivatamityetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<1.3.4>
tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhamiti pratipadyata etadvāva bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham, iti | yato jajña ugrastveṣa nṛmṇa ityato hyeṣa jāta ugrastveṣa nṛmṇaḥ, iti | sadyo jajñāno niriṇāti śatrūniti sadyo hyeṣa jātaḥ pāpmānamapāhata, iti | anu yaṃ viśve madantyūmā iti bhūtāni vai viśva ūmāsta enamanu madantyudagādudagāditi, iti | vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojā ityeṣa vai vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojā iti, iti | śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti, iti | avyanacca vyanacca sasnīti yacca prāṇi yaccāprāṇakamityeva tadāha, iti | saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣviti tava sarvaṃ vaśa ityeva tadāha, iti | tve kratumapi bṛñjanti viśva iti tvayīmāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni sarvāṇi manāṃsi sarve kratavo'pi vṛñjantītyeva tadāha, iti | dviryadete trirbhavantyūmā iti dvau vai santau mithunau prajāyete prajātyai, iti | prajāyate prajayā paśubhirya evaṃ veda, iti | svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samiti mithunaṃ vai svādu prajā svādu mithunenaiva tatprajāṃ saṃsṛjati, iti | adaḥ sumadhu madhunā'bhiyodhīriti mithunaṃ vai madhu prajā madhu mithunenaiva tatprajāmabhiyudhyati, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā svāṃ yattanūṃ tanvāmairayatetyasyāṃ śārīryāmimāṃ chandomayīmityeva tadāha iti | tanūreva tanvo astu bheṣajamityasyai śārīryā iyaṃ chandomayītyeva tadāha, iti | tasyai yānyaṣṭāvakṣarāṇi sā gāyatrī yānyekādaśa sā triṣṭubyāni dvādaśa sā jagatyatha yāni daśa sā virāḍdaśinyeṣu triṣu cchandaḥsu pratiṣṭhitā, iti | puruṣa iti tryakṣaraṃ sa u virāji, iti | etāni vāva sarvāṇi cchandāṃsi yānyetāni virāṭ caturthānyevamu haivaivaṃ viduṣa etadahaḥ sarvaiśchandobhiḥ pratipannaṃ bhavati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 ||
<1.3.5>
tā nadena viharati puruṣo vai nadastasmātpuruṣo vadantsarvaḥ saṃnadatīva, iti | nadaṃ va odatīnāmitīm̐3 āpo vā odatyo yā divyāstā hīdaṃ sarvamundantyāpo vā odatyo yā mukhyāstā hīdaṃ sarvamannādyamundanti, iti | nadaṃ yoyuvatīnāmitī3 āpo vāva yoyuvatyo yā antarikṣyāstā hi poplūyanta ivā''po vāva yoyuvatyo yāḥ svedate tā hi sarīsṛpyanta iva, iti | patiṃ vo aghnyānāmitīm̐3 āpo vā aghnyā yā agnerdhūmājjāyanta āpo vā aghnyā yāḥ śiśnātprasṛjyante, iti | dhenūnāmiṣudhyasītīm̐3 āpo vāva dhenavastā hīdaṃ sarva dhinvantīṣudhyasīti yadāha patīyasītyeva tadāha, iti | triṣṭubhaṃ cānuṣṭubhaṃ ca viharati vṛṣā vai triṣṭubyoṣā'nuṣṭuptanmithunaṃ tasmādapi puruṣo jāyāṃ vittvā kṛsnataramivā''tmānaṃ manyate, iti | tāstriḥ prathamayā pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti pañcaviṃśa ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ prajāpatirdaśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa pādyā dvā ūrū dvau bāhū ātmaiva pañcaviṃśastamimamātmānaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ saṃskurute'tho pañcaviṃśaṃ vā etadahaḥ pañcaviṃśa etasyāhnaḥ stomastatsamena samaṃ pratipadyate tasmāddve eva pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 ||
<1.3.6>
taditi pratipadyate tattaditi vā annamannameva tadabhipratipadyata etāṃ vāva prajāpatiḥ prathamāṃ vācaṃ vyāharadekākṣaradvyakṣarā tateti tāteti tathaivaitatkumāraḥ prathamavādī vācaṃ vyāharatyekākṣaradvyakṣarāṃ tateti tāteti tayaiva tattatavatyā vācā pratipadyate taduktamṛṣiṇā bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agramityetaddhyeva prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānā iti vācā hi nāmadheyāni dhīyante yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsīdityetaddhyeva śreṣṭhametadaripraṃ preṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhā''viritīdamu ha guhā'dhyātmamimā devatā ada u āviradhidaivatamityetattaduktaṃ bhavati,iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 6 ||
<1.3.7>
tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhamiti pratipadyate yadvai jyeṣṭhaṃ tanmahanmahadvadrūpasamṛddhametasyāho rūpam, iti | tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitveti mahadvadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | bhūya idvāvadhe vīryāyeti vīryavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | nṛṇāmu tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhirukthairityukthaṃ vā etadaharukthavadrūpasamṛddhametasyāhno rūpam, iti | nyūnākṣare prathame pade viharati nyūne vai retaḥ sicyate nyūne prāṇā nyūne'nnādyaṃ pratiṣṭhitameteṣāṃ kāmānāmavaruddhyā etānkāmānavarundhe ya evaṃ veda, iti | dve daśākṣare bhavata ubhayorannādyayorupāptyai yacca padvadyaccāpādakamityaṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśākṣarāṇi bhavanti yāni daśa nava prāṇā ātmaiva daśamaḥ sā''tmanaḥ saṃskṛtiraṣṭāvaṣṭā udyante'śnute yadyatkāmayate ya evaṃ veda, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 7 ||
<1.3.8>
tā nadena viharati prāṇo vai nadastasmātprāṇo nadantsarvaḥ saṃnadatīva, iti | nadaṃ va odatīnāmitīm̐3 uṣṇigakṣarai rbhavatyanuṣṭuppādairāyurvā uṣṇigvāganuṣṭuptadasminnāyuśca vācaṃ ca dadhāti, iti | tāstriḥ prathamayā pañcaviṃśatirbhavanti pañcaviṃśa ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ prajāpatirdaśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa pādyā dvā ūrū dvau vāk ātmaiva pañcaviṃśastamimamātmānaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ saṃskurute'tho pañcaviṃśaṃ vā etadahaḥ pañcaviṃśa etasyāhnaḥ stomastatsamena samaṃ pratipadyate tasmādvai eva pañcaviṃśatirbhavantītyadhyātmaṃ pañcaviṃśaḥ, iti | athādhidaivataṃ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vākprāṇastā etāḥ pañca devatā imaṃ viṣṭāḥ puruṣaṃ pañco haivaitā devatā ayaṃ viṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ so'trā'' lomabhya ā nakhebhyaḥ sarvaḥ sāṅga āpyate tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtānyā pipīlikābhya āptānyeva jāyante, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | sahasradhā pañcadaśānyuktheti pañca hi daśato bhavanti iti | yāvaddyāvāpṛthivī tāvadittaditi yāvatī vai dyāvāpṛthivī tāvānātmā, iti | sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasramityukthānyeva tadanu madati mahayati, iti | yāvadbrahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāgiti yatra ha kva ca brahma tadvāgyatra vā vāktadvā brahmetyetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti | eṣāṃ vā eṣāṃ sūktānāṃ navarcaṃ prathamaṃ nava vai prāṇāḥ prāṇānāṃ klṛptyai, iti | ṣalṛcama bhavati ṣaḍvā ṛtava ṛtūnāmāptyai, iti | pañcarcaṃ bhavati pañcapadā paṅktiḥ paṅktirvā annamannādyasyāvaruddhyai, ityādi | tṛco bhavati trayo vā ime trivṛto lokā eṣāmeva lokānāmabhijityai, iti | tā abhi saṃpadyante bṛhatī chando'mṛtaṃ devalokameṣa ātmaivamu haivaivaṃ videtayaiva saṃpadā'mṛtamevā''tmānamabhisaṃbhavati saṃbhavati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye'ṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 8 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
atha prathamāraṇyake caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | 1.4.1>
atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti | athāto grīvāstā ācakṣate yathā chandasamuṣṇiha iti, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti | athātaḥ śirastadgāyatrīṣu bhavatyagraṃ vai chandasāṃ gāyatryagramaṅgānāṃ śirastadarkavatīṣu bhavatyagnirvā arkastā nava bhavanti navakapālaṃ vai śiro daśamīṃ śaṃsati tvakkeśā ityeva sā bhavatyatho stomātiśaṃsanāyā eva tau trivṛcca stomau bhavato gāyatraṃ ca cchanda etayorvai stomacchandasoḥ prajātimanu sarvamidaṃ prajāyate yadidaṃ kiṃca prajātyai, iti | prajāyate prajayā paśubhirya evaṃ veda, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti | athāto vijavastā virājo bhavanti tasmātpuruṣaḥ puruṣamāha vi vā asmāsu rājasi grīvā vai dhārayasīti stabhamānaṃ vā yadvā drutāḥ saṃbāhlatamāḥ satyo'nnatamāṃ pratyacyante'nnaṃ hi virālannamu vīryam, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake caturthādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<1.4.2>
athāto dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ so'yaṃ lokaḥ so'yamagniḥ sā vāktadrathaṃtaraṃ sa vasiṣṭhastacchataṃ tāni ṣaḍvīryāṇi bhavanti saṃpāta eva kāmānāmabhyāptyai pratiṣṭhityā annādyāya paṅktiḥ, iti | athāta uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ so'sau lokaḥ so'sāvādityastanmanastadbṛhatsa bharadvājastacchataṃ tāni ṣaḍvīryāṇi bhavanti saṃpāta eva kāmānāmabhyāptyai pratiṣṭhityā annādyāya paṅktiḥ, iti | tā ūnātiriktau bhavato vṛṣā vai vṛhadyoṣā rathaṃtaramatiriktaṃ vai puṃso nyūnaṃ striyai tasmāt, iti | ūnātiriktau bhavato'tho ekena ha vai putreṇa suparṇasyottaraḥ pakṣo jyāyāṃstasmādekayarcottaraḥ pakṣo bhūyānbhavati, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti | athātaḥ pucchaṃ tā ekaviṃśatardvipadā bhavantyekaviṃśatirhīmāni pratyañci suparṇasya patrāṇi bhavanti, iti | atho ekaviṃśo vai stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā pratiṣṭhā pucchaṃ vayasām, iti | dvāviṃśī śaṃsati pratiṣṭhayoreva tadrūpaṃ kriyate tasmātsarvāṇi vayāṃsi pucchena pratitiṣṭhanti pucchenaiva pratiṣṭhāyotpatanti pratiṣṭhā hi puccham, iti | sa eṣa dvābhyāṃ daśinībhyāṃ virāḍbhyāmanayordvāviṃśyordvipadayorayaṃ puruṣaḥ pratiṣṭhitastasya yatsuparṇarūpaṃ tadasya kāmānāmabhyāptyā atha yatpuruṣarūpaṃ tadasya śriyai yaśase'nnādyāyāpacityai, iti | atha sūdadohā atha dhāyyā'tha sūdadohā vṛṣā vai sūdadohā yoṣā dhāyyā tadubhayataḥ sūdadohasā dhāyyā pariśaṃsati tasmāddvayo retaḥ siktaṃ sadekatāmevāpyeti yoṣāmevābhyata ājānā hi yoṣā'taḥ prajānā tasmādenāmatra śaṃsati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<1.4.3>
[ gāyatrīṃ tṛcāśītiṃ śaṃsatyayaṃ vai loko gāyatrī tṛcāśītiryadevāsmim̐lloke yaśo yanmaho yanmithunaṃ yadannādyaṃ yā'pacitistadaśnavai tadāpnavāni tadavaruṇadhai tanme'saditi, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ [ prāṇenemaṃ lokaṃ saṃtanoti, iti | bārhatīṃ tṛcāśītiṃ śaṃsatyantarikṣaloko vai bārhatī tṛcāśītiryadevāntarikṣaloke yaśo yanmaho yanmithunaṃ yadannādyaṃ yā'pacitistadaśnavai tadāpravāni tadavaruṇadhai tanme'sadityatha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇenāntarikṣalokaṃ saṃtanoti, iti | auṣṇihīṃ tṛcāśītiṃ śaṃsatyasau vai loko dyaurauṣṇihī tṛcāśītiryadevāmuṣmim̐loke yaśo yanmaho yanmithunaṃ yadannādyaṃ yā'pacitiryaddevānāṃ daivaṃ tadaśnavai tadāpnavāni tadavaruṇadhai tanme'sadityatha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇenāmuṃ lokaṃ saṃtanoti saṃtanoti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake caturthādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<1.5.1>
atha prathamāraṇyake pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | tatra prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | (viṃśaḥ) vaśaṃ śaṃsati vaśe ma idaṃ sarvamasaditi, [ iti |] tā ekaviṃśatirbhavantyekaviṃśatirhi tā antarudare vikṛtayaḥ, iti | atho ekaviṃśo vai stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā pratiṣṭhodaramannādyānām, iti | tā vicchandaso bhavanti vikṣudramiva vā antastyamaṇīya iva ca sthavīya iva ca, iti | tāḥ praṇāvaṃ chandaskāraṃ yathopapādaṃ śaṃsati yathopapādamiva vā antastyaṃ hasīya iva ca drāghīya iva ca, iti | atha sūdadohāḥ prāṇo vai sūdadohāḥ prāṇena parvāṇi saṃdadhāti, iti | tāmatrotsṛjati dvādaśakṛtvaḥ śastvā dvādaśavidhā vā ime prāṇāḥ sapta śīrṣaṇyā dvau stanyau trayo'vāñco'tra vai prāṇā āpyante'tra saṃskriyante tasmādenāmatrotsṛjati, iti | indrāgnī yuvaṃ su na ityaindrāgnā ūrū urvaṣṭhīve pratiṣṭhe, iti | tāḥ ṣaṭpadā bhavanti pratiṣṭhāyā eva dvipratiṣṭho vai puruṣaścatuṣpādāḥ paśavo yajamānameva taddvipratiṣṭhaṃ catuṣpātsu paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati, iti | dvitīyā saptapadā bhavati tāṃ gāyatrīṃ cānuṣṭubhaṃ ca karoti brahma vai gāyatrī vāganuṣṭubbrahmaṇaiva tadvācaṃ saṃdadhāti, iti | triṣṭubhamantataḥ śaṃsati vīryaṃ vai triṣṭubvīryeṇaiva tatpaśūnparigacchati tasmātpaśavo vīyarmanūpatiṣṭhanta īryatāṃ caivābhyutthānaṃ ca, iti ||] ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake pañcamādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<1.5.2>
pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhasa ityaindre niṣkevalye tāstriṣṭubjagatyo bhavanti, iti | tadāhuratha kasmāttriṣṭubjagatīṣu nividaṃ dadhātīti na ha vā etasyāhna ekaṃ chando nividaṃ dādhāra na vivyāceti tasmāstriṣṭubjagatīṣu nividaṃ dadhāti, iti | tadetadahastrinivitkaṃ vidyādvaśo nividvālakhilyā nivinnivideva nividevamenattrinivitkaṃ vidyāt, iti | atha sūkte vanena vāyo nyadhāyi cākanyo jāta eva prathamo manasvāniti, iti | tayorastyanne samasya yadasanmanīṣā ityannādyasyāvaruddhyai, iti | athā''vapanamete antareṇaindrīṇāṃ daśatīnāṃ triṣṭubjagatīnāṃ saṃpannānāṃ yāvatīrāvapante tāvantyūrdhvamāyuṣo varṣāṇi jīvantyetena haivā''vapanenā''yurāpyate, iti | prajāṃ me paśavo'rjayannityeva sajanīyamanu śaṃsati, iti | tārkṣyaṃ śaṃsati svastyayanaṃ vai tārkṣyaḥ svastitāyai svastyayanameva tatkurute, iti | ekapadā śaṃsatyekadhedaṃ sarvamasānītyatho sarvāṃ chandaskṛtimāpnavānīti, iti| | indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhanniti padānuṣaṅgāstāḥ saptānuṣajati sapta vai śīrṣanprāṇāḥ śīrṣanneva tatprāṇāndadhātyaṣṭamīṃ nānuṣajati vāgaṣṭamī nenme vākprāṇairanuṣaktā'saditi tasmādu sā vāksamānāyatanā prāṇaiḥ satyananuṣaktā iti | virājaḥ śaṃsatyannaṃ vai virājo'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai, iti | indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhanniti padānuṣaṅgāstāḥ saptānuṣajati sapta vai śīrṣanprāṇāḥ śīrṣanneva tatprāṇāndadhātyaṣṭamīṃ nānuṣajati vāgaṣṭamī nenme vākprāṇairanuṣaktā'saditi tasmādu sā vāksamānāyatanā prāṇaiḥ satyananuṣaktā, iti | virājaḥ śaṃsatyannaṃ vai virājo'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai, iti | vāsiṣṭhena paridadhāti vasiṣṭho'sānīti, iti | eṣa stomo maha ugrāya vāha iti mahadvatyā rūpasamṛddhayā, iti | dhurī vātyo na vājayannadhāyītyanto vai dhūranta etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | indra tvā'yamarka īṭṭe vasūnāmityarkavatyā rūpasamṛddhayā, iti | divīva dyāmadhi naḥ śromataṃ dhā iti yatra ha kva ca brahmaṇyā vāgudyate taddhāsya kīrtirbhavati yatraivaṃ vidvānetayā paridadhāti tasmādevaṃ vidvānetayaiva paridadhyāt, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake pañcamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<1.5.3>
tatsaviturvṛṇīmahe'dyā no deva savitariti vaiśvadevasya pratipadanucarāvaikāhikau rūpasamṛddhau, iti | bahu vā etasminnahani kiṃca kiṃca vāraṇaṃ kriyate śāntyā eva śāntirvai pratiṣṭhaikāhaḥ śāntyāmeva tatpratiṣṭhāyāmantataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | taddevasya saviturvāryaṃ mahaditi sāvitramanto vai mahadanta etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | katarā pūrvā katarā'parā'yoriti dyāvāpṛthivīyaṃ samānodarkaṃ samānodarkaṃ vā etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | anaśvo jāto anabhīśurukthya ityārbhavam, iti | rathastricakra iti pade tattrivattadanto vai trivadanta etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | asya vāmasya palitasya hoturiti vaiśvadevaṃ bahurūpaṃ vā etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | gaurīrmimāya salilāni takṣatītyetadantam, iti | ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvata iti vaiśvadevaṃ nividdhānamaikāhikaṃ rūpasamṛddham, iti | bahu vā etasminnahani kiṃca kiṃca vāraṇaṃ kriyate śāntyā eva śāntirvai pratiṣṭhaikāhaḥ śāntyāmeva tatpratiṣṭhāyāmantataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda yeṣāṃ caivaṃ vidvānetaddhotā śaṃsati, iti | vaiśvānarāya dhiṣaṇāmṛtāvṛdhe ityāgnimārutasya pratipadanto vai dhiṣaṇā'nta etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | pra yajyavo maruto bhrājadṛṣṭaya iti mārutaṃ samānodarkaṃ samānodarkaṃ vā etadaharetasyāhno rūpam, iti | jātavedase sunavāma somamiti jātavedasyāṃ purastātsūktasya śaṃsati svastyayanaṃ vai jātavedasyā svastitāyai svastyayanameva tatkurute, iti | imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedasa iti jātavedasyaṃ samānodarkaṃ samānodarkaṃ vā etadaharetasyāhno rūpamahno rūpam, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake pañcamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 || iti bahavṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyake pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 5 || iti bahavṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe prathamāraṇyakaṃ samāptam || 1 ||
<2.1.1>
atha dvitīyāraṇyakam | prathamo'dhyāyaḥ | tatraprathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ eṣa panthā etatkarmaitadbrahmaitatsatyam, iti | tasmānna pramādyettannātīyāt, iti | na hyatyāyanpūrve ye'tyāyaṃste parā babhūvuḥ,iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyurnya1nyā arkamabhito viviśre | bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣvantaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśeti, iti | prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyuriti yā vai tā imāḥ prajāstisro atyāyamāyaṃstānīmāni vayāṃsi vaṅgāvagadhāścerapādāḥ, iti | nya1nyā arkamabhito viviśra iti tā imāḥ prajā arkamabhito niviṣṭā imamevāgnim, iti | bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣvantarityada u eva bṛhadbhuvaneṣvantarasāvā'dityaḥ, iti | pavamāno harita ā viveśeti vāyureva pavamāno diśo harita āviṣṭaḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ||1 ||
<2.1.2>
pṛthivīto hīdaṃ sarvamuttiṣṭhati yadidaṃ kiṃca, iti | tasyāgnirarko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | antarikṣamevokthamantarikṣaṃ vā anu patantyantarikṣamanu dhāvayanti tasya vāyurarko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | asāveva dyaurukthamamutaḥpradānāddhīdaṃ sarvamuttiṣṭhati yadidaṃ kiṃca tasyāsāvādityo'rko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | ityadhidaivatamathādhyātmam, iti | puruṣa evokthamayameva mahānprajāpatirahamukthamasmīti vidyāt, iti | tasya mukhamevokthaṃ yathā pṛthivī tathā, iti | tasya vāgarko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | nāsike evokthaṃ yathā'ntarikṣaṃ tathā, iti | tasya prāṇo'rko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | tadetadbradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ yadetannāsikāyai vinatamiva, iti | lalāṭamevokthaṃ yathā dyaustathā tasya cakṣurarko'nnamaśītayo'nnena hīdaṃ sarvamaśnute, iti | samānamaśītayo'dhyātmaṃ cādhidaivataṃ cānnamevānnena hīmāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni samanantīm̐3 annenemaṃ lokaṃ jayatyannenāmuṃ tasmātsamānamaśītayo'dhyātmaṃ cādhidaivataṃ cānnameva, iti | tadidamannamannādamiyameva pṛthivīto hīdaṃ sarvamuttiṣṭhati yadidaṃ kiṃca, iti | yaddha kiṃcedaṃ prertā3i tadasau sarvamatti yadu kiṃcātaḥ praitīm̐ 3 tadiyaṃ sarvamatti seyamityādyā'ttrī, iti | attā ha vā ādyo bhavati, iti | na tasyeśe yannādyādyadvainaṃ nādyuḥ, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<2.1.3>
athāto retasaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpate reto devā devānāṃ reto varṣe varṣasya reta oṣadhaya oṣadhīnāṃ reto'nnamannasya reto reto retaso retaḥ prajāḥ prajānāṃ reto hṛdayaṃ hṛdayasya reto mano manaso reto vāgvāco retaḥ karma tadidaṃ karma kṛtamayaṃ puruṣo brahmaṇo lokaḥ, iti | sa irāmayo yaddhīrāmayastasmāddhiraṇmayaḥ, iti | hiraṇmayo ha vā amuṣmim̐lloke saṃbhavati hiraṇmayaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo dadṛśe ya evaṃ veda, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye tṛtīya khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<2.1.4>
taṃ prapadābhyāṃ prāpadyata brahmemaṃ puruṣaṃ yatprapadābhyāṃ prāpadyata brahmemaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmātprapade tasmātprapade ityācakṣate śaphāḥ khurā ityanyeṣāṃ paśūnām, iti | tadūrdhvamudasarpattā ūrū abhavatām, iti | uru gṛṇīhītyabravīttadudaramabhavat, iti| urveva me kurvityabravīttaduro'bhavat, iti | udaraṃ brahmeti śārkarākṣyā upāsate hṛdayaṃ brahmetyāruṇayo brahmāhaiva tā3i, iti | ūrdhvaṃ tvevodasarpattacchiro'śrayata yacchiro'śrayata tacchiro'bhavattacchirasaḥ śirastvam, iti | tā etāḥ śīrṣañchriyaḥ śritāścakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vākprāṇaḥ, iti | śrayante'smiñchriyo ya evametacchirasaḥ śirastvaṃ veda, iti | tā ahiṃsantāhamukthamasmyahamukthamasmīti tā abruvanhantāsmāccharīrādutkrāmāma tadyasminna utkrānta idaṃ śarīraṃ patspati tadukthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, iti | vāgudakrāmadavadannaśnanpibannāstaiva cakṣurudakrāmadapaśyannaśnanpibannāstaiva śrotramudakrāmadaśṛṇvannaśnanpiba nnāstaiva mana utkrāmanmīlita ivāśnanpibannāstaiva prāṇa udakrāmattatprāṇa utkrānte'padyata, iti | tadaśīryatāśārītīm̐3 taccharīrama bhavattaccharīrasya śarīratvam, iti | śīryate ha vā asya dviṣanpāpmā bhrātavyaḥ parā'sya dviṣanpāpmā bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda, iti | tā ahiṃsantaivāhamukthamasmyahamukthamasmīti tā abruvanhantedaṃ punaḥ śarīraṃ praviśāma tadyasminnaḥ prapanna idaṃ śarīramutthāsyati tadukthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, iti | vākprāviśadaśayadeva cakṣuḥ prāviśadaśayadeva śrotraṃ prāviśadaśayadeva manaḥ prāviśadaśayadeva prāṇaḥ prāviśattatprāṇe prapanna udatiṣṭhattadukthamabhavat, iti | tadetadukthām̐3 prāṇa eva, iti prāṇa ukthamityeva vidyāt, iti | taṃ devā abruvantvamukthamasi tvamidaṃ sarvamasi tava vayaṃ smastvamasmākamasīti, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktaṃ tvamasmākaṃ tava smasīti, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 ||
<2.1.5>
taṃ devāḥ prāṇayanta sa praṇītaḥ prātāyata prātāyītīm̐3 tatprātarabhavatsamāgāditīm̐2 tatsāyamabhavadahareva prāṇo rātrirapānaḥ, iti | vāgagniścakṣurasāvādityaścandramā mano diśaḥ śrotraṃ sa eṣa prahitāṃ saṃyogo'dhyātmamimā devatā ada u āviradhidaivatamityetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti | etaddha sma vai tadvidvānāha hiraṇyadanbaido na tasyeśe yaṃ mahyaṃ na dadyuriti prahitāṃ vā ahamadhyātmaṃ saṃyogaṃ niviṣṭaṃ vedaitaddha tat, iti | anīśānāni ha vā asmai bhūtāni baliṃ haranti ya evaṃ veda, iti | tatsattyaṃ saditi prāṇastītyannaṃ yamityasāvādityastadetattrivṛttrivṛdiva vai cakṣuḥ śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kanīniketi, iti | sa yadi ha vā api mṛṣā vadati sattyaṃ haivāsyoditaṃ bhavati ya evametatsattyasya sattyatvaṃ veda iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 ||
<2.1.6>
tasya vāktantirnāmāni dāmāni tadasyedaṃ vācā tantyā nābhirdāmabhiḥ sarvaṃ sitaṃ sarvaṃ hīdaṃ nāmanīm̐3 sarvaṃ vācā'bhivadati, iti | vahanti ha vā enaṃ tantisaṃbaddhā ya evaṃ veda, iti | tasyoṣṇiglomāni tvaggāyatrī triṣṭummāṃsamanuṣṭupsnāvānyasthi jagatī paṅktirmajjā prāṇo bṛhatī sa cchandobhiśchanno yacchandobhiśchannastasmācchandāṃsītyācakṣate, iti | chādayanti ha vā enaṃ chandāṃsi pāpātkarmaṇo yasyāṃ kasyāṃciddiśi kāmayate ya evametacchandasāṃ chandastvaṃ veda, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | apaśyaṃ gopāmityeṣa vai gopā eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ gopāyati, iti | anipadyamānamiti na hyeṣa kadācana saṃviśati, iti | ā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantamityā ca hyeṣa parā ca pathibhiścarati, iti | sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna iti sadhrīcīśca hyeṣa viṣūcīśca vasta imā eva diśaḥ, iti | āvarīvarti bhuvaneṣvantarityeṣa hyantarbhuvaneṣvāvarīvarti, iti | atho āvṛtāso'vatāso na kartṛbhiriti, iti | sarvaṃ hīdaṃ prāṇenā''vṛtam, iti | so'yamākāśaḥ prāṇena bṛhatyā viṣṭabdhastadyathā'yamākāśaḥ prāṇena bṛhatyā viṣṭabdha evaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyā pipīlikābhyaḥ prāṇena bṛhatyā viṣṭabdhānītyevaṃ vidyāt, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 6 ||
<2.1.7>
athāto vibhūtayo'sya puruṣasya, iti | tasya vācā sṛṣṭau pṛthivī cāgniścāsyāmoṣadhayo jāyante'gnirenāḥ svadayatīdamāharatedamāharatetyevametau vācaṃ pitaraṃ paricarataḥ pṛthivī cāgniśca, iti | yāvadanu pṛthivī yāvadanvagnistāvānasya loko bhavati nāsya tāvalloko jīryate yāvadetayorna jīryate pṛthivyāścāgneśca ya evametāṃ vāco vibhūtiṃ veda, iti | prāṇena sṛṣṭāvantarikṣaṃ ca vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ vā anu carantyantarikṣamanu śṛṇvanti vāyurasmai puṇyaṃ gandhamāvahatyevametau prāṇaṃ pitaraṃ paricarato'ntarikṣaṃ ca vāyuśca yāvadanvantarikṣaṃ yāvadanu vāyustāvānasya loko bhavati nāsya tāvalloko jīryate yāvadetayorna jīryante'ntarikṣasya ca vāyośca ya evametāṃ prāṇasya vibhūtiṃ veda, iti | cakṣuṣā sṛṣṭau dyauścā''dityaśca dyaurhāsmai vṛṣṭima nnādyaṃ saṃprayacchatyādityo'sya jyotiḥ prakāśaṃ karotyevametau cakṣuḥ pitaraṃ paricarato dyauścā''dityaśca yāvadanu dyauryāvadanvādityastāvānasya loko bhavati nāsya tāvalloko jīryate yāvadetayorna jīryate divaścā''dityasya ca ya evametāṃ cakṣuṣo vibhūtiṃ veda, iti | śrotreṇa sṛṣṭā diśaśca candramāśca digbhyo hainamāyatīm̐3 digbhyo viśṛṇoti candramā asmai pūrva pakṣāparapakṣānvicinoti puṇyāya karmaṇa evamete śrotraṃ pitaraṃ paricaranti diśaśca candramāśca yāvadanu diśo yāvadanu candramāstāvānasya loko bhavati nāsya tāvalloko jīryate yāvadeteṣāṃ na jīryate diśāṃ ca candramasaśca ya evametāṃ śrotrasya vibhūtiṃ veda, iti | manasā sṛṣṭā āpaśca varuṇaścā''po hāsmai śraddhāṃ saṃnamante puṇyāya karmaṇe varuṇo'sya prajāṃ dharmeṇa dādhāraivamete manaḥ pitaraṃ paricarantyāpaśca varuṇaśca yāvadanvāpo yāvadanu varuṇastāvānasya loko bhavati nāsya tāvalloko jīryate yāvadeteṣāṃ na jīryate'pāṃ ca varuṇasya ca ya evametāṃ manaso vibhūtiṃ veda, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 7 ||
<2.1.8>
āpā3 ityāpa iti tadidamāpa evedaṃ vai mūlamadastūlamayaṃ pitaite putrā yatra ha kva ca putrasya tatpituryatra vā pitustadvā putrasyetyetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti | etaddha sma vai tadvidvānāha mahidāsa aitareya ā'haṃ māṃ devebhyo veda o maddevānvedetaḥpradānā hyeta itaḥsaṃbhṛtā iti, iti | sa eṣa giriścakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vākprāṇastaṃ brahmagirirityācakṣate, iti | girati ha vai dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ parā'sya dviṣa npāpmā bhrātṛvyo .bhavati ya eva veda, iti | sa eṣo'suḥ sa eṣa prāṇaḥ sa eṣa bhūtiścābhūtiśca, iti | taṃ bhūtiriti devā upāsāṃcakrire te babhūvu'stasmāddhāpyetarhi supto bhūrbhūrityeva praśvasiti, iti | abhūtirityasurāste parābabhūvuḥ, iti | bhavatyātmanā parā'sya dviṣanpāpmā bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda, iti | sa eṣa mṛtyuścaivāmṛtaṃ ca, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | apāṅprāṅeti svadhayā gṛbhīta ityapānena hyayaṃ yataḥ prāṇo na parāṅbhavati, iti | amartyo martyenā sayonirityetena hīdaṃ sarvaṃ sayoni martyāni hīmāni śarīrāṇīm̐3 amṛtaiṣā devatā, iti | tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā nya1nyaṃ cikyurna nicikyuranyamiti nicinvanti haivemāni śarīrāṇīm̐3 amṛtaivaiṣā devatā, iti | amṛto ha vā amuṣmim̐lloke saṃbhavatyamṛtaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo dadṛśe ya evaṃ veda ya evaṃ veda, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye'ṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 8 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<2.2.1>
atha dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | tatra prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | (navamaḥ)
eṣa imaṃ lokamabhyārcatpuruṣarūpeṇa ya eṣa tapati prāṇo vāva tadabhyārcatprāṇo hyeṣa ya eṣa tapati taṃ śataṃ varṣāṇyabhyārcattasmācchataṃ varṣāṇi puruṣāyuṣo bhavanti taṃ yacchataṃ varṣāṇyabhyārcattasmācchatarcinastasmācchatarcina ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | sa idaṃ sarvaṃ madhyato dadhe yadidaṃ kiṃca sa yadidaṃ sarvaṃ madhyato dadhe yadidaṃ kiṃca tasmānmādhyamāstasmānmādhyamā ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | prāṇo vai gṛtso'pāno madaḥ sa yatprāṇo gṛtso'pāno madastasmādgṛtsamadastasmādgṛtsamada ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | tasyedaṃ viśvaṃ mitramāsīdyadidaṃ kiṃca tadyadasyedaṃ viśvaṃ mitramāsīdyadidaṃ kiṃca tasmādviśvāmitrastasmādviśvāmitra ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | taṃ devā abruvannayaṃ vai naḥ sarveṣāṃ vāma iti taṃ yaddevā abruvannayaṃ vai naḥ sarveṣāṃ vāma iti tasmādvāma devastasmādvāmadeva ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | sa idaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmano'trāyata yadidaṃ kiṃca sa yadidaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmano'trāyata yadidaṃ kiṃca tasmādatrayastasmādatraya ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<2.2.2>
eṣa u eva bibhradvājaḥ prajā vai vājastā eṣa bibharti yadbibharti tasmādbharadvājasta smādbharadvāja ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | taṃ devā abruvannayaṃ vai naḥ sarveṣāṃ vasiṣṭha iti taṃ yaddevā abruvannayaṃ vai naḥ sarveṣāṃ vasiṣṭha iti tasmādvasiṣṭhastasmādvasiṣṭha ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | sa idaṃ sarvamabhiprāgādyadidaṃ kiṃca sa yadidaṃ sarvamabhiprāgādyadidaṃ kiṃca tasmātpragāthāsta smātpragāthā ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | sa idaṃ sarvamabhyapavayata yadidaṃ kiṃca sa yadidaṃ sarvamabhyapavayata yadidaṃ kiṃca tasmātpāvamānyastasmātpāvamānya ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | so'bravīdahamidaṃ sarvamasāni yacca kṣudraṃ yacca mahaditi te kṣudrasūktāścābhavanmahāsūktāśca tasmātkṣudrasūktāstasmātkṣudrasūktā ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | sūktaṃ batāvocateti tatsūktamabhavattasmātsūktaṃ tasmātsūktamityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | eṣa vā ṛgeṣa hyebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo'rcata sa yadebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo'rcata tasmādṛktasmādṛgityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | eṣa vā ardharca eṣa hyebhyaḥ sarvebhyo'rdhebhyo'rcata sa yadebhyaḥ sarvebhyo'rdhebhyo'rcata tasmādardharcastasmādardharca ityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | eṣa vai padameṣa hīmāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni pādi sa yadimāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni pādi tasmātpadaṃ tasmātpadamityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | eṣa vā akṣarameṣa hyebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ kṣarati na cainamatikṣaranti sa yadebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ kṣarati na cainamatikṣaranti tasmādakṣaraṃ tasmādakṣaramityācakṣata etameva santam, iti | tā vā etāḥ sarvā ṛcaḥ sarve vedāḥ sarve ghoṣā ekaiva vyāhṛtiḥ prāṇa eva prāṇa ṛca ityeva vidyāt, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<2.2.3>
viśvāmitraṃ hyetadahaḥ śaṃsiṣyantamindra upaniṣasasāda sa hānnamityabhivyāhṛtya bṛhatīsahasraṃ śaśaṃsa tenendrasya priyaṃ dhāmopeyāya, iti | tamindra uvāca ṛṣe priyaṃ vai me dhāmopāgāḥ sa vā ṛṣe dvitīyaṃ śaṃseti sa hānnamityevābhivyāhṛtya bṛhatīsahasraṃ śaśaṃsa tenendrasya priyaṃ dhāmopeyāya, iti | tamindra uvāca ṛṣe priyaṃ vai te dhāmopāgāḥ sa vā ṛṣe tṛtīyaṃ śaṃseti sa hānnamityevābhivyāhṛtya bṛhatīsahasraṃ śaśaṃsa tenendrasya priyaṃ dhāmopeyāya, iti | tamindra uvāca ṛṣe priyaṃ vai me dhāmopāgā varaṃ te dadāmīti sa hovāca tvāmeva jānīyāmiti tamindra uvāca prāṇo vā ahamasmyṛṣe prāṇastvaṃ prāṇaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni prāṇo hyeṣa ya eṣa tapati sa etena rūpeṇa sarvā diśo viṣṭo'smi tasya me'nnaṃ mitraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tadvaiśvāmitrameṣa tapannevāsmīti hovāca, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<2.2.4>
tadvā idaṃ bṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tasya yāni vyañjanāni taccharīraṃ yo ghoṣaḥ sa ātmā ya ūṣmāṇaḥ sa prāṇaḥ, iti | etaddha sma vai tadvidvānvasiṣṭho vasiṣṭho babhūva tata etannāmadheyaṃ lebhe, iti | etadu haivendro viśvāmitrāya provācaitadu haivendro bharadvājāya provāca tasmātsa tena bandhunā yajñeṣu hūyate, iti | tadvā idaṃ vṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tasya vā etasya bṛhatīsahasrasya saṃpannasya ṣaṭtriṃśatamakṣarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavanti tāvanti śatasaṃvatsarasyāhnāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavanti vyañjanaireva rātrīrāpnuvanti svarairahāni, iti | tadvā idaṃ bṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tasya vā etasya bṛhatīsahasrasya saṃpannasya parastātprajñāmayo devatāmayo brahmamayo'mṛtamayaḥ saṃbhūya devatā apyeti ya evaṃ veda, iti | tadyo'haṃ so'sau yo'sau so'ham, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśceti, iti | etadu haivopekṣetopekṣeta, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.3.1>
yo ha vā ātmānaṃ pañcavidhamukthaṃ veda yasmādidaṃ sarvamuttiṣṭhati sa saṃprativitpṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotīṃṣītyeṣa vā ātmokthaṃ pañcavidhametasmāddhīdaṃ sarvamuttiṣṭhatyetamevāpyetyayanaṃ ha vai samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda, iti | tasminyo'nnaṃ cānnādaṃ ca vedāhāsminnannādo jāyate bhavatyasyānnamāpaśca pṛthivī cānnametanmayāni hyannāni bhavanti jyotiśca vāyuścānnādametābhyāṃ hīdaṃ sarvamannamattyāvapanamākāśa ākāśe hīdaṃ sarvaṃ samopyata āvapanaṃ ha vai samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda, iti | tasminyo'nnaṃ cānnādaṃ ca vedāhāsminnannādo jāyate bhavatyasyānnamoṣadhivanaspatayo'nnaṃ prāṇabhṛto'nnādamoṣadhivanaspatīnhi prāṇabhṛto'danti, iti | teṣāṃ ya ubhayatodantāḥ puruṣasyānuvidhā vihitāste'nnādā annamitare paśavastasmātta itarānpaśūnadhīva carantyadhīva hyanne'nnādo bhavati, iti | adhīva ha samānānāṃ jāyate ya evaṃ veda, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<2.3.2>
tasya ya ātmānamāvistarāṃ vedāśnute hā''virbhūyaḥ, iti | oṣadhivanaspatayo yacca kiṃca prāṇabhṛtsa ātmānamāvistarāṃ vedauṣadhivanaspatiṣu hi raso dṛśyate cittaṃ prāṇabhṛtsu, iti | prāṇabhṛtsu tvevā''vistarāmātmā teṣu hi raso'pi dṛśyate na cittamitareṣu, iti | puruṣe tvevā''vistarāmātmā sa hi prajñānena saṃpannatamo vijñātaṃ vadati vijñātaṃ paśyati veda śvastanaṃ veda lokālokau martyenāmṛtamīpsatyevaṃ saṃpannaḥ, iti | athetareṣāṃ paśūnāmaśanāpipāse evābhivijñānaṃ na vijñātaṃ vadanti na vijñātaṃ paśyanti na viduḥ śvastanaṃ na lokālokau ta etāvanto bhavanti yathāprajñaṃ hi saṃbhavāḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<2.3.3>
sa eṣa puruṣaḥ samudraḥ sarvaṃ lokamati yaddha kiṃcāśnute'tyenaṃ manyate yadyantarikṣalokamaśnute'tyenaṃ manyate yadyamuṃ lokamaśnuvītātyevainaṃ manyeta, iti | sa eṣa puruṣaḥ pañcavidhastasya yaduṣṇaṃ tajjyotiryāni khāni sa ākāśo'tha yallohitaṃ śleṣmā retastā āpo yaccharīraṃ sā pṛthivī yaḥ prāṇaḥ sa vāyuḥ, iti | sa eṣa vāyuḥ pañcavidhaḥ prāṇo'pāno vyāna udānaḥ samānastā etā devatāḥ prāṇāpānayoreva niviṣṭāścakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vāgiti prāṇasya hyanvapāyametā apiyanti, iti | sa eṣa vācaścittasyottarottarikramo yadyajñaḥ sa eṣa yajñaḥ pañcavidho'gnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau cāturmāsyāni paśuḥ somaḥ sa eṣa yajñānāṃ saṃpannatamo yatsoma etasminhyetāḥ pañca vidhā adhigamyante yatprāksavanebhyaḥ saikā vidhā trīṇi savanāni yadūrdhvaṃ sā pañcamī, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<2.3.4>
yo ha vai yajñe yajñaṃ vedāhanyahardeveṣu devamadhyūhlaṃ sa saṃprativideṣa vai yajñe yajño'hanyahardeveṣu devo'dhyūhlo yadetanmahaduktham, iti | tadetatpañcavidhaṃ trivṛtpañcadaśaṃ saptadaśamekaviṃśaṃ pañcaviṃśamiti stomato gāyatraṃ rathaṃtaraṃ vṛhadbhadraṃ rājanamiti sāmato gāyatryuṣṇigbṛ hatītriṣṭubdvipadeti cchandastaḥ śiro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣa uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ pucchamātmetyākhyānam, iti | pañcakṛtvaḥ prastauti pañcakṛtva udgāyati pañcakṛtvaḥ pratiharati pañcakṛtva upadravati pañcakṛtvo nidhanamupayanti tatstobhasahasraṃ bhavati, iti | evaṃ hyetāḥ pañca vidhā anuśasyante yatprāktṛcāśītibhyaḥ saikā vidhā tisrastṛcāśītayo yadūrdhvaṃ sā pañcamī, iti | tadetatsahasraṃ tatsarvaṃ tāni daśa daśeti vai sarvametāvatī hi saṃkhyā daśa daśatastacchataṃ daśa śatāni tatsahasraṃ tatsarvaṃ tāni trīṇi cchandāṃsi bhavanti tredhā vihitaṃ vā idamannamaśanaṃ pānaṃ khādastadetairāpnoti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | | 4 | |
<2.3.5>
taddhaitadeke nānācchandasā sahasraṃ pratijānate kimanyatsadanyadbrūyāmeti, iti | triṣṭupsahasrameke jagatīsahasrameke'nuṣṭupsahasrameke, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | anuṣṭubhamanu cañcūryamāṇamindraṃ nicikyuḥ kavayo manīṣeti vāci vai tadaindraṃ prāṇaṃ nyacāyannityetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti | sa heśvaro yaśasvī kalyāṇakīrtirbhavitoḥ, iti | īśvaro ha tu purā''yuṣaḥ praitoriti ha smā''hākṛtsno hyeṣa ātmā yadvāgabhi hi prāṇe na manase'syamāno vācā nānubhavati, iti | bṛhatīmabhi saṃpādayedeṣa vai kṛtsna ātmā yadbṛhatī, iti | so'yamātmā sarvataḥ śarīraiḥ parivṛtastadyathā'yamātmā sarvataḥ śarīraiḥ parivṛta evameva bṛhatī sarvataśchandobhiḥ parivṛtā, iti | madhyaṃ hyeṣāmaṅgānāmātmā madhya chandasāṃ bṛhatī, iti | sa heśvaro yaśasvī kalyāṇakīrtirbhavitorīśvaro ha tu purā''yuṣaḥ praitoriti ha smā''ha kṛtsno hyeṣa ātmā yadbṛhatī tasmādbṛhatīmevābhi saṃpādayet, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 ||
<2.3.6>
tadvā idaṃ bṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tasya vā etasya bṛhatīsahasrasya saṃpannasyaikādaśānuṣṭubhāṃ śatāni bhavanti pañcaviṃśatiścānuṣṭubha āttaṃ vai bhūyasā kanīyaḥ, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | vācamaṣṭāpadīmahamityaṣṭau hi caturakṣarāṇi bhavanti, iti | navasraktimiti bṛhatī saṃpadyamānā navasrakti , iti | ṛtaspṛśamiti satyaṃ vai vāgṛcā spṛṣṭā, iti | indrātpari tanvaṃ mama iti tadyadevaitadbṛhatīsahasramanuṣṭupsaṃpannaṃ bhavati tasmāttadaindrātprāṇādbṛhatyai vācamanuṣṭubhaṃ tanvaṃ saṃnirmimīte, iti | sa vā eṣa vācaḥ paramo vikāro yadetanmahadukthaṃ tadetatpañcavidhaṃ mitamamitaṃ svaraḥ satyānṛte iti, iti | ṛggāthā kumbyā tanmitaṃ yajurnigado vṛthā vāktadamitaṃ sāmātho yaḥ kaśca geṣṇaḥ sa svara omiti satyaṃ netyanṛtam, iti | tadetatpuṣpaṃ phalaṃ vāco yatsatyaṃ sa heśvaro yaśasvī kalyāṇakīrtirbhavitoḥ puṣpaṃ hi phalaṃ vācaḥ satyaṃ vadati, iti | athaitanmūlaṃ vāco yadanṛtaṃ tadyathā vṛkṣa āvirmūlaḥ śuṣyati sa udvartata evamevānṛtaṃ vadannāvirmūlamātmānaṃ karoti sa śuṣyati sa udvartate tasmādanṛtaṃ na vadeddayeta tvenena, iti | parāgvā etadriktamakṣaraṃ yadetado3miti tadyatkiṃcomityāhātraivāsmai tadricyate sa yatsarvamoṃ kuryādriñcyādātmānaṃ sa kāmebhyo nālaṃ syāt, iti | athaitatpūrṇamabhyātmaṃ yanneti sa yatsarvaṃ neti brūyātpāpikā'sya kīrtirjāyeta sainaṃ tatraiva hanyāt, iti | tasmātkāla eva dadyātkāle na dadyāttatsatyānṛte mithunī karoti tayormithunātprajāyate bhūyānbhavati, iti | yo vai tāṃ vācaṃ veda yasyā eṣa vikāraḥ sa saṃpratividakāro vai sarvā vāksaiṣā sparśoṣmabhirvyajyamānā bahvī nānārūpā bhavati, iti | tasyai yadupāṃśu sa prāṇo'tha yaduccaistaccharīraṃ tasmāttattira iva tira iva hyaśarīramaśarīro hi prāṇo'tha yaduccaistaccharīraṃ tasmāttadāvirāvirhi śarīram, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 6 ||
<2.3.7>
tadvā idaṃ bṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tadyaśaḥ sa indraḥ sa bhūtānāmadhipatiḥ sa ya evametamindraṃ bhūtānāmadhipatiṃ veda visrasā haivāsmāllokātpraitīti ha smā''ha mahidāsa aitareyaḥ pretyendro bhūtvaiṣu lokeṣu rājati, iti | tadāhuryadanena rūpeṇāmuṃ lokamabhisaṃbhavatīm̐3 atha kena rūpeṇemaṃ lokamābhavatīm̐3, iti | tadyadetatstriyāṃ lohitaṃ bhavatyagnestadrūpaṃ tasmāttasmānna bībhatsetātha yadetatpuruṣe reto bhavatyādityasya tadrūpaṃ tasmāttasmānna bībhatseta so'yamātmemamātmānamamuṣmā ātmane saṃprayacchatyasāvātmā'mumātmānamimasmā ātmane saṃprayacchati tāvanyonyamabhisaṃbhavato'nenāha rūpeṇāmuṃ lokamabhisaṃbhavatyamuno rūpeṇemaṃ lokamābhavati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 7 ||
<2.3.8>
tatraite ślokāḥ 3, iti | yadakṣaraṃ pañcavidhaṃ sameti yujo yuktā abhiyatsaṃvahanti | satyasya satyamanu yatra yujyate tatra devāḥ sarva ekaṃ bhavanti, iti | yadakṣarādakṣarameti yuktaṃ yujo yuktā abhi yatsaṃvahanti | satyasya śṛṇu yatra yujyate tatra devāḥ sarva ekaṃ bhavanti, iti | yadvāca omiti yacca neti yaccāsyāḥ krūraṃ yadu colbaṇiṣṇu | tadviyūyā kavayo anvavindannāmāyattā samatṛpyañcchṛte'dhi iti | yasminnāmā samatṛpyañcchṛte'dhi tatra devāḥ sarvayujo bhavanti | tena pāpmānamapahatya brahmaṇā svargaṃ lokamapyeti vidvān, iti | nainaṃ vācā striyaṃ bruvannainamastrīpumānbruvan | pumāṃsaṃ na bruvannenaṃ vadanvadati kaścana, iti | aḥ iti brahma tatrā''gatamahamiti, iti | tadvā idaṃ bṛhatīsahasraṃ saṃpannaṃ tasya vā etasya bṛhatīsahasrasya saṃpannasya ṣaṭtriṃśatamakṣarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavanti tāvanti puruṣāyuṣo'hnāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavanti jīvākṣareṇaiva jīvāharāpnoti jīvāhnā jīvākṣaramiti, iti | anakāmamāro'tha devarathastasya vāguddhiḥ śrotre pakṣasī cakṣuṣī yukte manaḥ saṃgrahītā tadayaṃ prāṇo'dhitiṣṭhati, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | ā tena yātaṃ manaso javīyasā nimiṣaścijjavīyaseti javīyaseti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye'ṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 8 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<2.4.1>
atha dvitīyāraṇyake caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | tatra prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | (ekaviṃśaḥ) ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīnnānyatkiṃcana miṣat, iti | sa īkṣata lokānnu sṛjā iti sa imām̐llokānasṛjata, iti | ambho marīcīrmaramāpaḥ, iti | ado'mbhaḥ pareṇa divaṃ dyauḥ pratiṣṭhā'ntarikṣaṃ marīcayaḥ pṛthivī maro yā adhastāttā āpaḥ, iti | sa īkṣateme lokā lokapālānnu sṛjā iti | so'dya eva puruṣaṃ samuddhṛtyāmūrchayat, iti | tamabhyatapattasyābhitaptasya mukhaṃ nirabhidyata yathā'ṇḍaṃ mukhādvāgvāco'gnirnāsike nirabhidyetāṃ nāsikābhyāṃ prāṇaḥ prāṇādvāyurakṣiṇī nirabhidyetāmakṣībhyāṃ cakṣuścakṣuṣa ādityaḥ karṇo nirabhidyetāṃ karṇābhyāṃ śrotraṃ śrotrāddiśastvaṅnirabhidyata tvaco lomāni lomabhya oṣadhivanaspatayo hṛdayaṃ nirabhidyata hṛdayānmano manasaścandramā nābhirnirabhidyata nābhyā apāno'pānānmṛtyuḥ śiśnaṃ nirabhidyata śiśnādreto retasa āpaḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake caturthādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<2.4.2>
tā etā devatāḥ sṛṣṭā asminmahatyarṇave prāpataṃstamaśanāpipāsābhyāmanvavārjat, iti | tā enamabruvannāyatanaṃ naḥ prajānīhi yasminpratiṣṭhitā annamadāmeti tābhyo gāmānayattā abruvanna vai no'yamalamiti tābhyo'śvamānayattā abruvann vai no'yamalamiti tābhyaḥ puruṣamānayattā abruvantsukṛtaṃ bateti puruṣo vāva sukṛtam, iti | tā abravīdyathāyatanaṃ praviśateti, iti | agnirvāgbhūtvā mukhaṃ prāviśadvāyuḥ prāṇo bhūtvā nāsike prāviśadādityaścakṣurbhūtvā'kṣiṇī prāviśaddiśaḥ śrotraṃ bhūtvā karṇau prāviśannoṣadhivanaspatayo lomāni bhūtvā tvacaṃ prāviśaṃścandramā mano bhūtvā hṛdayaṃ prāviśanmṛtyurapāno bhūtvā nābhiṃ prāviśadāpo reto bhūtvā śiśnaṃ prāviśan, iti | tamaśanāpipāse abrūtāmāvābhyāmabhi prajānīhīti te abravīdetāsveva vāṃ devatāsvābhajāmyetāsu bhāginyau karomīti tasmādyasya kasyai ca devatāyai havirgṛhyate bhāginyāvevāsyāmaśanāpipāse bhavataḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<2.4.3>
sa īkṣateme nu lokāśca lokapālāścānnamebhyaḥ sṛjā iti so'po'bhyatapattābhyo'bhitaptābhyo mūrtirajāyata yā vai sā mūrtirajāyatānnaṃ vai tat, iti | tadenatsṛṣṭaṃ parāṅatyajighāṃsattadvācā'jighṛkṣattannāśaknodvācā grahītuṃ sa yaddhainadvācā'grahaiṣyadabhivyāhṛtya haivānnamatrapsyattatprāṇenājighṛkṣattannāśakrotprāṇena grahītuṃ sa yaddhai natprāṇenāgrahaiṣyadabhiprāṇya haivānnamatrapsyaccakṣuṣā'jighṛkṣattannāśaknoccakṣuṣā grahītuṃ sa yaddhainaccakṣuṣā'grahaiṣyaddṛṣṭvā haivānnamatrapsyattacchrotreṇājighṛkṣattannāśaknocchrotreṇa grahītuṃ sa yaddhainacchrotreṇāgrahaiṣyacchrutvā haivānnamatrapsyattattvacā'jighṛkṣattannāśaknottvacā grahītuṃ sa yaddhainattvacā'grahaiṣyatspṛṣṭvā haivānnamatrapsyattanmanasā'jighṛkṣattannāśaknonmanasā grahītuṃ sa yaddhai nanmanasā'grahaiṣyaddhyātvā haivānnamatrapsyattacchiśnenājighṛkṣattannāśaknocchiśnena grahītuṃ sa yaddhainacchiśnenāgrahaiṣyadvisṛjya haivānnamatrapsyattadapānenājighṛkṣattadāvayat, iti | saiṣo'nnasya graho yadvāyurannāyurvā eṣa yadvāyuḥ, iti | sa īkṣata kathaṃ nvidaṃ madṛte syāditi, iti | sa īkṣata katareṇa prapadyā iti, iti | sa īkṣata yadi vācābhivyāhṛtaṃ yadi prāṇenābhi prāṇitaṃ yadi cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭaṃ yadi śrotreṇa śrutaṃ yadi tvacā spṛṣṭaṃ yadi manasā dhyātaṃ yadyapānenābhyapānitaṃ yadi śiśnena visṛṣṭamatha ko'hamiti, iti | sa etameva sīmānaṃ vidāryaitayā dvārā prāpadyata, iti | saiṣā vidṛtirnāma dvāstadetannāndanam, iti | tasya traya āvasathāstrayaḥ svapnā ayamāvasatho'yamāvasatho'yamāvasatha iti, iti | sa jāto bhūtānyabhivyaikhyatkimihānyaṃ vāvadiṣaditi sa etameva puruṣaṃ brahmatatamamapaśyat, iti | idamadarśamitīm̐3 tasmādidandro nāmedandro ha vai nāma tamidandraṃ santamindra ityācakṣate parokṣeṇa parokṣapriyā iva hi devāḥ parokṣapriyā iva hi devāḥ, iti ||
ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake caturthādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<2.5.1>
puruṣe ha vā ayamādito garbho bhavati yadetadretaḥ, iti | tadetatsarvebhyo'ṅgebhyastejaḥ saṃbhṛtamātmanyevā''tmānaṃ bibharti tadyadā striyāṃ siñcatyathainajjanayati tadasya prathamaṃ janma, iti | tatstriyā ātmabhūyaṃ gacchati yathā svamaṅgaṃ tathā tasmādenāṃ na hinasti, iti | sā'syaitamātmānamatra gataṃ bhāvayati sā bhāvayitrī bhāvayitavyā bhavati, iti | taṃ strī garbhe bibharti so'gra eva kumāraṃ janmano'gre'dhibhāvayati, iti | sa yatkumāraṃ janmano'gre'dhibhāvayatyātmānameva tadbhāvayati, iti | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ saṃtatyā evaṃ saṃtatā hīme lokāḥ, iti | tadasya dvitīyaṃ janma, iti | so'syāyamātmā puṇyebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ pratidhīyate, iti | athāsyāyamitara ātmā kṛtakṛtyo vayogataḥ praiti, iti | sa itaḥ prayanneva punarjāyate tadasya tṛtīyaṃ janma, iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā, iti | garbhe nu sannanveṣāmavedamahaṃ devānāṃ janimāni viśvā | śataṃ mā pura āyasīrarakṣannadhaḥ śyeno javasā niradīyamiti, iti | garbha evaitacchayāno vāmadeva evamuvāca sa evaṃ vidvānasmāccharīrabhedādūrdhva utkramyāmuṣmintsvarge loke sarvānkāmānāptvā'mṛtaḥ samabhavatsamabhavat, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake pañcamādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<2.6.1>
atha dvitīyāraṇyake ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | tatra prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ( pañcaviṃśaḥ)
ko'yamātmeti vayamupāsmahe kataraḥ sa ātmā, iti | yena vā paśyati yena vā śṛṇoti yena vā gandhānājighrati yena vā vācaṃ vyākaroti yena vā svādu cāsvādu ca vijānāti yadetaddhṛdayaṃ manaścaitatsaṃjñānamājñānaṃ vijñānaṃ prajñānaṃ medhā dṛṣṭirdhṛtirmatirmanīṣā jūtiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃkalpaḥ kraturasuḥ kāmo vaśa iti, iti | sarvāṇyevaitāni prajñānasya nāmadheyāni bhavanti, iti | eṣa brahmaiṣa indra eṣa prajāpatirete sarve devā imāni ca pañca mahābhūtāni pṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotīṃṣītānīmāni ca kṣudramiśrāṇīva bījānītarāṇi cetarāṇi cāṇḍajāni ca jārujāni ca svedajāni codbhijāni cāśvā gāvaḥ puruṣā hastino yatkiṃcedaṃ prāṇi jaṅgamaṃ ca patatri ca yacca sthāvaraṃ sarvaṃ tatprajñānetram, iti | prajñāne pratiṣṭhitaṃ prajñānetro lokaḥ prajñā pratiṣṭhā, iti | prajñānaṃ brahma, iti | sa etena prajñenā''tmanā'smāllokādutkramyāmuṣmintsvarge loke sarvānkāmānāptvā'mṛtaḥ samabhavatsamabhavat, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake ṣaṣṭhādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.7.1>
vāṅme manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitamāvirāvīrma edhi vedasya ma āṇī sthaḥ śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīranenādhītenāhorātrāntsaṃdadhāmyṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi tanmāmavatu tadvaktāramavatvavatu māmavatu vaktāramavatu vaktāram, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake saptamādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyake saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe dvitīyāraṇyakaṃ samāptam || 2 ||
<3.1.1>
atha tṛtīyāraṇyakam | prathamo'dhyāyaḥ tatraprathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ
athātaḥ saṃhitāyā upaniṣat, iti | pṛthivī pūrvarūpaṃ dyauruttararūpaṃ vāyuḥ saṃhiteti māṇḍūkeya ākāśaḥ saṃhitetyasya mākṣavyo vedayāṃcakre, iti | sa hāviparihṛto mene na me'sya putreṇa samagāditi, iti | samāne vai tatparihṛto mena ityāgastyaḥ samānaṃ hyetadbhavati vāyuścā''kāśaśceti, iti | ityadhidaivatamathādhyātmam, iti | vākpūrvarūpaṃ mana uttararūpaṃ prāṇaḥ saṃhiteti śūravīro māṇḍūkeyaḥ, iti | atha hāsya putra āha jyeṣṭho manaḥ pūrvarūpaṃ vāguttararūpaṃ manasā vā agre saṃkalpayatyatha vācā vyāharati tasmānmana eva pūrvarūpaṃ vāguttararūpaṃ prāṇastveva saṃhiteti, iti | samānamenayoratra pituśca putrasya ca, iti | sa eṣo'śvarathaḥ praṣṭivāhano manovākprāṇasaṃhataḥ, iti | sa ya evametāṃ sahitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | iti nu māṇḍūkeyānām, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<3.1.2>
atha śākalyasya, iti | pṛthivī pūrvarūpaṃ dyauruttararūpaṃ vṛṣṭiḥ saṃdhiḥ parjanyaḥ saṃdhātā, iti | tadutāpi yatraitadbalavadanūdgṛhṇantsaṃdadhadahorātre varṣati, iti | dyāvāpṛthivyau samadhātāmityutāpyāhuḥ, iti | itī nvadhidaivatamathādhyātmam, iti | puruṣo ha vā ayaṃ sarva āndaṃ dve bidale bhavata ityāhustasyedameva pṛthivyā rūpamidaṃ divastatrāyamantareṇā''kāśo yathā'sau dyāvāpṛthivyāvantareṇā''kāśastasminhasminnākāśe prāṇa āyatto yathā'muṣminnākāśe vāyurāyatto yathā'mūni trīṇi jyotīṃṣyevamimāni puruṣe trīṇi jyotīṃṣi, iti | yathā'sau divyāditya evamidaṃ śirasi cakṣuryathā'sāvantarikṣe vidyudevamidamātmani hṛdayaṃ yathā'yamagniḥ pṛthivyāmevamidamupasthe retaḥ, iti | evamu ha sma sarvalokamātmānamanuvidhāyā''hedameva pṛthivyā rūpamidaṃ divaḥ, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<3.1.3>
athāto nirbhujapravādāḥ, iti | pṛthivyāyatanaṃ nirbhujaṃ divyāyatanaṃ pratṛṇṇamantarikṣāyatanamubhayamantareṇa, iti | atha yadyenaṃ nirbhujaṃ bruvantamupavadedacyoṣṭā'varābhyāṃ sthānābhyāmityenaṃ brūyādatha yadyenaṃ pratṛṇṇaṃ bruvantamupavadedacyoṣṭā uttarābhyāṃ sthānābhyāmityenaṃ brūyādyastvevobhayamantareṇā''ha tasya nāstyupavādaḥ, iti | yaddhi saṃdhiṃ vivartayati tannirbhujasya rūpamatha yacchuddhe akṣare abhivyāharati tatpratṛṇṇasyāgra u evobhayamantareṇobhayaṃ vyāptaṃ bhavati, iti | annādyakāmo nirbhujaṃ brūyātsvargakāmaḥ pratṛṇṇamubhayakāma ubhayamantareṇa, iti | atha yadyenaṃ nirbhujaṃ bruvantaṃ para upavadetpṛthivīṃ devatāmāraḥ pṛthivī tvā devatā riṣyatītyenaṃ brūyādatha yadyenaṃ pratṛṇṇaṃ bruvantaṃ para upavadeddivaṃ devatāmāro dyaustvā devatā riṣyatītyenaṃ brūyādathayadyenamubhayamantareṇa bruvantaṃ para upavadedantarikṣaṃ devatāmāro'ntarikṣaṃ tvā devatā riṣyatītyenaṃ brūyāt, iti | yathā tu kayā ca bruvanvā'bruvantaṃ vā brūyādabhyāśameva yattathā syāt, iti | na tvevānyatkuśalādbrāhmaṇaṃ brūyāt, iti | atidyumna eva brāhmaṇaṃ brūyāt, iti | nātidyumne cana brāhmaṇaṃ brūyānnamo astu brāhmaṇebhya iti ha smā''ha śūravīro māṇḍūkeyaḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<3.1.4>
athāto'nuvyāhārāḥ, iti | prāṇo vaṃśa iti vidyāt, iti | sa ya enaṃ prāṇavaṃśamupavadecchaknuvancenmanyeta prāṇaṃ vaṃśaṃ samadhā3m, prāṇaṃ mā vaṃśaṃ saṃdadhataṃ na śaknoṣītyāha prāṇastvā vaṃśo hāsyatītyenaṃ brūyāta, iti | atha cedaśaknuvantaṃ manyeta prāṇaṃ vaṃśaṃ samadhitsiṣantaṃ nāśakaḥ saṃdhātuṃ prāṇastvā vaṃśo hāsyatītyenaṃ brūyāt, iti | yathā tu kathā ca bruvanvā'bruvantaṃ vā brūyādabhyāśameva yattathā syānna tvevānyatkuśalādbrāhmaṇaṃ brūyādatidyumna eva brāhmaṇaṃ brūyānnātidyumne cana brāhmaṇaṃ brūyānnamo astu brāhmaṇebhya iti ha smā''ha śūravīro māṇḍūkeyaḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 ||
<3.1.5>
atha khalvāhurnirbhujavaktrāḥ, iti | pūrvamakṣaraṃ pūrvarūpamuttaramuttararūpaṃ yo'vakāśaḥ pūrvarūpottararūpe antareṇa sā saṃhiteti, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | atha vayaṃ brūmo nirbhujavaktrā iti ha smā''ha hrasvo māṇḍūkeyaḥ pūrvamevākṣaraṃ pūrvarūpamuttaramuttararūpaṃ yo'vakāśaḥ pūrvarūpottararūpe antareṇa yena saṃdhiṃ vivartayati yena svarāsvaraṃ vijānāti yena mātrāmātrāṃ vibhajate sā saṃhiteti iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | atha hāsya putra āha madhyamaḥ prātībodhīputro'kṣare khalvime avikarṣannanekīkurvanyathāvarṇamāha tadyā'sau mātrā pūrvarūpottararūpe antaraṇe saṃdhivijñapanī sāma tadbhavati sāmaivāhaṃ saṃhitāṃ manya iti, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | bṛhaspate na paraḥ sāmno viduriti, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 ||
<3.1.6>
vṛhadrathaṃtarayo rūpeṇa saṃhitā saṃdhīyata iti tārkṣyaḥ, iti | vāgvai rathaṃtarasya rūpaṃ prāṇo bṛhata ubhābhyāmu khalu saṃhitā saṃdhīyate vācā ca prāṇena ca, iti | etasyāṃ ha smopaniṣadi saṃvatsaraṃ gā rakṣayate tārkṣyaḥ, iti| etasyāṃ ha sma mātrāyāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ gā rakṣayate tārkṣyaḥ, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | vākprāṇena saṃhiteti kauṇṭharavyaḥ prāṇaḥ pavamānena pavamāno viśvairdevairviśve devāḥ svargeṇa lokena svargo loko brahmaṇā saiṣā'varaparā saṃhitā, hati | sa yo haitāmavaraparāṃ saṃhitāṃ vedaivaṃ haiva sa prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena saṃdhīyate yathaiṣā saṃhitā, iti | sa yadi pareṇa vopasṛtaḥ svena vā'rthenābhivyāharedabhivyāhārṣanneva vidyāddivaṃ saṃhitā'gamadviduṣāṃ devānāmevaṃ bhaviṣyatīti śaśvattathā syāt, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | vāksaṃhiteti pañcālacaṇḍaḥ, iti | vācā vai vedāḥ saṃdhīyante vācā chandāṃsi vācā mitrāṇi saṃdadhati vācā sarvāṇi bhūtānyatho vāgevedaṃ sarvamiti, iti | tadyatraitadadhīte vā bhāṣate vā vāci tadā prāṇo bhavati vāktadā prāṇaṃ rehlyatha yatra tūṣṇīṃ vā bhavati svapiti vā prāṇe tadā vāgbhavati prāṇastadā vācaṃ rehli tāva nyonyaṃ rīhlo vāgvai mātā prāṇaḥ putraḥ, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramāviveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vicaṣṭe | taṃ pākena manasā'paśyamantitastaṃ mātā rehli sa u rehli mātaramiti, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti, iti | athātaḥ prajāpatisaṃhitā, iti | jāyā pūrvarūpaṃ patiruttararūpaṃ putraḥ saṃdhiḥ prajananaṃ saṃdhānaṃ saiṣā'ditiḥ saṃhitā, iti | aditirhīdaṃ sarvaṃ yadidaṃ kiṃca pitā ca mātā ca putraśca prajananaṃ ca, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | aditirmātā sa pitā sa putra iti, iti | sa ya evametāṃ saṃhitāṃ veda saṃdhīyate prajayā paśubhiryaśasā brahmavarcasena svargeṇa lokena sarvamāyureti sarvamāyureti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamādhyāye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 6 || iti bahavṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<3.2.1>
prāṇo vaṃśa iti sthaviraḥ śākalyastadyathā śālāvaṃśe sarve'nye vaṃśāḥ samāhitāḥ syurevamasminprāṇe cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vāgindriyāṇi śarīraṃ sarva ātmā samāhitaḥ, iti| tasyaitasyā''tmanaḥ prāṇa ūṣmarūpamasthīni sparśarūpaṃ majjānaḥ svararūpaṃ māṃsaṃ lohitamityetadanyaccaturthamantasthā rūpamiti ha smā''ha hrasvo māṇḍūkeyaḥ, iti | trayaṃ tveva na etatproktam, iti | tasyaitasya trayasyāsthnāṃ majjñāṃ parvaṇāmiti trīṇītaḥ ṣaṣṭi śatāni trīṇītastāni saptaviṃśatiśatāni bhavanti sapta ca vai śatāni viṃśatiśca saṃvatsarasyāhorātrāḥ sa eṣo'haḥsaṃmānaścakṣurmayaḥ śrotramayaścha ndomayo manomayo vāṅmaya ātmā, iti | sa ya evametamahaḥsaṃmānaṃ cakṣurmayaṃ śrotramayaṃ chandomayaṃ manomayaṃ vāṅmayamātmānaṃ vedāhnāṃ sāyujyaṃ sarūpatāṃ salokatāmaśnute putrī paśumānbhavati sarvamāyureti, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<3.2.2>
atha kauṇṭharavyaḥ, iti | trīṇi ṣaṣṭi śatānyakṣarāṇāṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭi śatānyūṣmaṇāṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭi śatāni saṃdhīnām, iti | yānyakṣarāṇyavocāmāhāni tāni yānūṣmaṇo'vocāma rātrayastā yāntsaṃdhīnavocāmāhorātrāṇāṃ te saṃdhaya ityadhidaivatam, iti | athādhyātmaṃ yānyakṣarāṇyadhidaivatamavocāmāsthīni tānyadhyātmaṃ yānūṣmaṇo'dhidaivatamavocāma majjānaste'dhyātmam, iti | eṣa ha vai saṃprati prāṇo yanmajjaitadreto na ha vā ṛte prāṇādretaḥ sicyate yadvā ṛte prāṇādretaḥ sicyeta pūyenna saṃbhavet iti | yāntsaṃdhīnadhidaivatamavocāma parvāṇi tānyadhyātmam iti | tasyaitasya trayasyāsthnāṃ majjñāṃ parvaṇāmiti pañcetaśca tvāriṃśacchatāni pañcetastadaśītisahasraṃ bhavatyaśītisahasraṃ vā arkalino bṛhatīraharabhisaṃpādayanti , iti | sa eṣo'kṣarasaṃmānaścakṣurmayaḥ śrotramayaśchandomayo manomayo vāṅmaya ātmā, iti | sa ya evametamakṣarasaṃmānaṃ cakṣurmayaṃ śrotramayaṃ chandomayaṃ manomayaṃ vāṅmayamātmānaṃ vedākṣarāṇāṃ sāyujyaṃ sarūpatāṃ salokatāmaśnute putrī paśumānbhavati sarvamāyureti, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<3.2.3>
catvāraḥ puruṣā iti bādhvaḥ, iti | śarīrapuruṣaśchandaḥpuruṣo vedapuruṣo mahāpuruṣa iti, iti | śarīrapuruṣa iti yamavocāma sa ya evāyaṃ daihika ātmā tasya yo'yamaśarīraḥ prajñātmā sa rasaḥ, iti | chandaḥpuruṣa iti yamavocāmākṣarasamāmnāya eva tasyaitasyākāro rasaḥ, iti | vedapuruṣa iti yamavocāma yena vedānveda ṛgvedaṃ yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ tasyaitasya brahmā rasaḥ, iti | tasmādbrahmāṇaṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ kurvīta yo yajñasyolbaṇaṃ paśyet, iti | mahāpuruṣa iti yamavocāma saṃvatsara eva pradhvaṃsayannanyāni bhūtānyaikyā bhāvayannanyāni tasyaitasyāsāvādityo rasaḥ, iti | sa yaścāyamaśarīraḥ prajñātmā yaścāsāvāditya ekametaditi vidyāttasmātpuruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyādityo bhavati, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśceti, iti | etāmanuvidhaṃ saṃhitāṃ saṃdhīyamānāṃ manya iti ha smā''ha bādhvaḥ, iti | etaṃ hyeva bahvṛcā mahatyukthe mīmāṃsanta etamagnāvadhvaryava etaṃ mahāvrate chandogā etamasyāmetaṃ divyetaṃ vāyāvetamākāśa etamapsvetamoṣadhīśvetaṃ vanaspatiṣvetaṃ candramasyetaṃ nakṣatreṣvetaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣvetameva brahmetyācakṣate, iti | sa eṣa saṃvatsarasaṃmānaścakṣurmayaḥ śrotramayaśchandomayo manomayo vāṅmaya ātmā, iti | sa ya evametaṃ saṃvatsarasaṃmānaṃ cakṣurmayaṃ śrotramayaṃ chandomayaṃ manomayaṃ vāṅmayamātmānaṃ parasmai śaṃsati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 ||
<3.2.4>
dugdhadohā asya vedā bhavanti na tasyānūkte bhāgo'sti na veda sukṛtasya panthānamiti, iti | tadapyetadṛṣiṇoktam, iti | yastityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti | yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti na hi praveda sukṛtasya panthāmiti, iti | na tasyānūkte bhāgo'sti na veda sukṛtasya panthānamityetattaduktaṃ bhavati, iti | tasmādevaṃ vidvānna parasmā agniṃ cinuyānna parasmai mahāvratena stuvīta na parasmā etadahaḥ śaṃset, iti | kāmaṃ pitre vā''cāryāya vā śaṃsedātmana evāsya tatkṛtaṃ bhavati, iti | sa yaścāyamaśarīraḥ prajñātmā yaścāsāvāditya ekametadi tyavocāma tau yatra vihīyete candramā ivā''dityo dṛśyate na raśmayaḥ prādurbhavanti lohinī dyaurbhavati yathā mañjiṣṭhā vyastaḥ pāyuḥ kākakulāyagandhikamasya śiro vāyati saṃpareto'syā'''tmā na ciramiva jīviṣyatīti vidyāt, iti | sa yatkaraṇīyaṃ manyeta tatkurvīta yadanti yacca dūraka iti sapta japedāditpratnasya retasa ityekā yatra brahmā pavamāneti ṣaludvayaṃ tamasasparītyekā, iti | athāpi yatra cchidra ivā''dityo dṛśyate rathanābhirivābhikhyāyeta cchidrāṃ vā chāyāṃ paśyettadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | athāpyādarśe vodake vā jihmaśirasaṃ vā'śirasaṃ vā''tmānaṃ paśyedviparyaste vā kanyāke jihmena vā dṛśyeyātāṃ tadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | athāpidhāyākṣiṇī upekṣeta tadyathā baṭarakāṇi saṃpatantīva dṛśyante tāni yadā na paśyettadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | athāpyapidhāya karṇā upaśṛṇuyātsa eṣo'gneriva prajvalato rathasyevopabdistaṃ yadā na śṛṇuyāttadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | athāpi yatra nīla ivāgnirdṛśyate yathā mayūragrīvā meghe vā vidyutaṃ paśyenmeghe vā vidyutaṃ na paśyenmahāmeghe vā marīcīriva paśyeta tadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | athāpi yatra bhūmiṃ jvalantīmiva paśyeta tadapyevameva vidyāt, iti | iti pratyakṣadarśanāni, iti | atha svapnāḥ, iti | puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇadantaṃ paśyati sa enaṃ hanti varāha enaṃ hanti markaṭa enamāskandayatyāśu vāyurenaṃ pravahati suvarṇaṃ khāditvā'pagirati madhvaśnāti bisāni bhakṣayatyekapuṇḍarīkaṃ dhārayati kharairvarāhairyuktairyāti kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ kṛṣṇavatsāṃ naladamālī dakṣiṇāmukho vrājayati, iti | sa yadyeteṣāṃ kiṃcitpaśyedupoṣya pāyasaṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā rātrīsūktena pratyṛcaṃ hutvā'nyenānnena brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā caruṃ svayaṃ prāśnīyāt, iti | sa yo'to'śruto'gato'mato'nato'dṛṣṭo'vijñāto'nādiṣṭaḥ śrotā mantā draṣṭā''deṣṭā ghoṣṭā vijñātā prajñātā sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmantarapuruṣaḥ sa ma ātmeti vidyāt, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 ||
<3.2.5>
atha khalviyaṃ sarvasyai vāca upaniṣatsarvā hyevemāḥ sarvasyai vāca upaniṣada imāṃ tvevā''cakṣate, iti | pṛthivyā rūpaṃ sparśā antarikṣasyoṣmaṇo divaḥ svarā agne rūpaṃ sparśā vāyorūṣmāṇa ādityasya svarā ṛgvedasya rūpaṃ sparśā yajurvedasyoṣmāṇaḥ sāmavedasya svarāścakṣuṣo rūpaṃ sparśāḥ śrotrasyoṣmāṇo manasaḥ svarāḥ prāṇasya rūpaṃ sparśā apānasyoṣmāṇo vyānasya svarāḥ, iti | atha khalviyaṃ daivī vīṇā bhavati tadanukṛtirasau mānuṣī vīṇā bhavati, iti | yathā'syāḥ śira evamamuṣyāḥ śiro yathā'syā udaramevamamuṣyā ambhaṇaṃ yathā'syai jihvaivamamuṣyai vādanaṃ yathā'syāstantraya evamamuṣyā aṅgulayo yathā'syāḥ svarā evamamuṣyāḥ svarā yathā'syāḥ sparśā evamamuṣyāḥ sparśā yathā hyeveyaṃ śabdavatī tardmavatyevamasau śabdavatī tardmavatī yathā hyeveyaṃ lomaśena carmaṇā'pihitā bhavatyevamasau lomaśena carmaṇā'pihitā, iti | lomaśena ha sma vai carmaṇā purā vīṇā apidadhati, iti | sa yo haitāṃ daivīṃ vīṇāṃ veda śrutavadano bhavati bhūmiprā'sya kīrtirbhavati yatra kvacā''ryā vāco bhāṣante vidurenaṃ tatra, iti | athāto vāgraso yasyāṃ saṃsadyadhīyāno vā bhāṣamāṇo vā na virurucuṣeta tatraitāmṛcaṃ japet, iti | oṣṭhāpidhānā na kulīdantaiḥ parivṛtā paviḥ | sarvasyai vāca īśānā cāru māmiha vādayediti vāgrasaḥ, iti | ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe tṛtīyāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 ||
<3.2.6>
