atha pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | tatra prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | (saptamaḥ) grīvāḥ, iti | yasyedamārajastujo yujo vanaṃ sahaḥ | indrasya rantyaṃ bṛhat, iti | nādhṛṣa ādadharṣadādhṛṣāṇaṃ dhṛṣitaṃ śavaḥ | purā yadīmativyathirindrasya dhṛṣitaṃ sahaḥ, iti | sa no dadātu taṃ rayiṃ rayiṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam | indraḥ patistavastamo janeṣvā, iti | sūdadohāḥ, iti | śiro gāyatramindramidgāthino bṛhaditi, iti| anyāsu cetsamāmnātāsu stuvīrannubhayāsaṃsthā na viparyayo'samāmnātāsu cetstuvīranmiśrāsu ca, iti | sūktasyottamāṃ sūdadohāḥ, iti | vijavaḥ, iti | sutaste soma upayāhi yajñaṃ matsvā madaṃ puruvāraṃ maghāya | maṃhiṣṭha indra vijuro gṛṇadhyai, iti | sasāhaturvṛtrahatyeṣu śatrūnṛbhurvigāha eṣaḥ | sa no netāraṃ mahayāma indram, iti | ino vasuḥ samajaḥ parvateṣṭhāḥ prati vāmṛjīṣī | indraḥ śaśvadbhirjohūtra evaiḥ, iti | sūdadohāḥ, iti | ityetattrayaṃ grīvā śiro vijavaḥ sarvamardharcyam, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<5.2.2>
rāthaṃtaro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ, iti | abhi tvā śūra nonumo'bhi tvā pūrvapītaya iti rathaṃtarasya stotriyānurūpau pragāthau catasraḥ satīḥ ṣaḍbṛhatīḥ karoti, iti | indrasya nu vīryāṇi pravocaṃ tve ha yatpitaraścinna indreti pañcadaśa yastigmaśṛṅga vṛṣabho na bhīma ugro jajñe vīryāya svadhāvānudu brahmāṇyairata śravasyā''te maha indro'tyugreti pañca sūktānyā na indro dūrādā na āsāditi saṃpāta itthā hi soma inmada iti paṅktiḥ sūdadohāḥ, iti | bārhata uttaraḥ, iti | tvāmiddhi havāmahe tvaṃ hyehi cerava iti bṛhataḥ stotriyānurūpau pragāthau catasraḥ satīḥ ṣaḍbṛhatīḥ karoti, iti | tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojāḥ suta ittvaṃ nimiśla indra soma iti trīṇyabhūreko rayipate rayīṇāmityaṣṭau sūktāni kathā mahāmavṛdhatkasya hoturiti saṃpāta indro madāya vāvṛdha iti paṅktiḥ sūdadohāḥ, iti | rāthaṃtaro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ pañcadaśaḥ stoma ekaśataṃ vasiṣṭhaprāsāhā bārhata uttaraḥ saptadaśaḥ stomo dviśataṃ bharadvājaprāsāhaḥ, iti | bhadraṃ pucchaṃ dvipadāsu, iti | imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmā''yāhi vanasā saheti nava samāmnātā athāsamāmnātāḥ, iti | pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprā gāthaṃ gāyata yajjujoṣat, iti | arcantyarkaṃ devatāsvarkā āstobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ, iti | upaprakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyanto rayiṃ dhīmahe tamindra, iti | viśvato dāvanviśvato na ābhara yaṃ tvā śaviṣṭhamīmahe, iti | sa supraṇīte nṛtamaḥ svarālasi maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye, iti || tvaṃ hyeka īśiṣe sanādamṛkta ojasā, iti | viśvasya prastobha vidvānpurā vā yadi vehā''sa nūnam, iti | iṣaṃ no mitrāvaruṇā kartanelāṃ pīvarīmiṣaṃ kṛṇuhī na indra, iti | śaṃ padaṃ maghaṃ rayiṣaṇi na somo avrataṃ hinoti na spṛśadrayiḥ, iti | eṣa brahmeti tisraḥ, iti | ādhūrṣvasmā ityekā sūdadohā yadvāvāneti dhāyyā sūdadohāḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 || ||
<5.2.3>
'gāyatrī tṛcāśītiḥ, iti | mahām̐ indro ya ojaseti tisra uttamā uddharati purolāśaṃ no andhasa iti tisra indra itsomapā eka ityetatprabhṛtīnāṃ tisra uttamā uddharati tāsāṃ svādavaḥ somā āyāhītyetāmuddhṛtya na hyanyaṃ balākaramityetāṃ pratyavadadhāti jajñāno nu śatakraturityekā puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutamiti śeṣa uddhedabhi śrutā maghamityuttamāmuddharati prakṛtānyṛjīṣiṇa ā ghā ye agnimindhata ā tū na indra kṣumantamiti sūkte sūdadohāḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 || ||
<5.2.4>
bārhatī tṛcāśītiḥ, iti | mā cidanyadviśaṃsatetyekayā na triṃśatpibā sutasya rasina iti viṃśateḥ saptamīṃ cāṣṭamīṃ coddharati yadindra prāgapāgudagiti caturdaśa vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta iti pañcadaśa mo ṣu tvā vāghataścanetyetasya dvipadāṃ coddharati rāthaṃtaraṃ ca pragāthamatha hāsya nakiḥ sudāso rathamityetaṃ pragāthamuddhṛtya tvāmidā hyo nara ityetaṃ pragāthaṃ pratyavadadhātyabhi pra vaḥ surādhasamiti ṣaḍvālakhilyānāṃ sūktāni yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇiriti śeṣo'yaṃ te astu haryata iti sūkte ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na iti saptamīṃ cāṣṭamīṃ coddharati tarobhirvo vidadvasumityuttamāmuddharati yo rājā carṣaṇīnāmityekādaśa taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahamā no viśvā suhavyo yā indra bhuja ābhara iti nava sūdadohāḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 4 ||
<5.2.5>
auṣṇihī tṛcāśītiḥ, iti | ya indra somapātama iti sūkte tamvabhi pragāyatetyuttamāmuddharatīndrāya sāma gāyata sakhāya āśiṣāmahīti tisra uttamā uddharati ya eka idvidayata āyāhyadribhiḥ sutaṃ yasya tyacchambaraṃ mada iti trayastṛcā gāyatryaḥ saṃpadoṣṇihaḥ sapta sapta gāyatryaḥ ṣaṭṣaluṣṇiho bhavanti yadindrāhaṃ yathā tvaṃ pra saṃmrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmiti sūkte uttarasyottame uddharati vārtrahatyāya śavasa ityuttamāmuddharati surūpakṛtnumūtaya iti trīṇyendrasānasiṃ rayimiti sūkte ya ānayatparāvata iti tisra uttamā uddharati revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda iti tisraḥ sūdadohāḥ, iti | ityetāstisrastṛcāśītayaḥ sarvā ardharcyāḥ, iti | annamaśītayaḥ, iti | udaraṃ vaśaḥ, iti | tvā'vataḥ purūvasaviti vaśaḥ sanitaḥ su sanitarityetadanto dadīrekṇa iti dvipadā nūnamathetyekapadā tā asya sūdadohasa ityetadantaḥ sūdadohāḥ sūdadohāḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyādhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 5 || iti bahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<5.3.1>
ūrū, iti | indrāgnī yuvaṃ su na ityetasyārdharcāngāyatrīkāramuttaramuttarasyānuṣṭupkāraṃ prāguttamāyāḥ pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhasa iti nividdhānaṃ vanena vāyo nyadhāyi cākanyo jāta eva prathamo manasvāniti te antareṇā''yāhyarvāṅupavandhureṣṭhā vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāmityetadāvapanaṃ daśatīnāmaindrīṇāṃ triṣṭubjagatīnāṃ bṛhatīsaṃpannānāṃ yāvatīrāvaperaṃstāvantyūrdhvamāyuṣo varṣāṇi jijīviṣetsaṃvatsarātsaṃvatsarāddaśato na vā tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtamindro viśvaṃ virājatītyekapadendraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhannityānuṣṭubhaṃ tasya prathamāyāḥ pūrvamardharcaṃ śastvottareṇārdharcenottarasyāḥ pūrvamardharcaṃ vyatiṣajati pādaiḥ pādānanuṣṭupkāraṃ prāguttamāyāḥ pūrvasmātpūrvasmādardharcāduttaramuttaramardharcaṃ vyatiṣajati prakṛtyā śeṣaḥ pibā somamindra mandatu tveti ṣaḍyoniṣṭa indra sadane akārītyetasya catasraḥ śastvottamāmupasaṃtatyopottamayā paridadhāti, iti | parihita uktha ukthasaṃpadaṃ japati, iti | ukthavīryasya sthāna ukthadohaḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 1 ||
<5.3.2>
mūrdhā lokānāmasi vāco rasastejaḥ prāṇasyā''yatanaṃ manasaḥ saṃveśaścakṣuṣaḥ saṃbhavaḥ śrotrasya pratiṣṭhā hṛdayasya sarvam | indraḥ karmākṣitamamṛtaṃ vyoma | ṛtaṃ satyaṃ vijigyānaṃ vivācanamanto vāco vibhuḥ sarvasmāduttaraṃ jyotirūdharaprativādaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ vākparāgarvāksapru salilaṃ dhenu pinvati | cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ prāṇaḥ satyasaṃmitaṃ vākprabhūtaṃ manaso vibhūtaṃ hṛdayograṃ brāhmaṇabhartṛmannaśubhe varṣapavitraṃ gobhagaṃ pṛthivyuparaṃ varuṇavayvitamaṃ tapastanvindrajyeṣṭhaṃ sahasradhāramayutākṣaramamṛtaṃ duhānam, iti | etāsta uktha bhūtaya etā vāco vibhūtayaḥ | tābhirma iha dhukṣvāmṛtasya śriyaṃ mahīm, iti | prajāpatiridaṃ brahma vedānāṃ sasṛje rasam | tenāhaṃ viśvamāpyāsaṃ sarvāntāmānduhāṃ mahat, iti | bhūrbhuvaḥ svastrayo vedo'si | brahma prajāṃ me dhukṣva, iti | āyuḥ prāṇaṃ me dhukṣva | paśūnviśaṃ me dhukṣva | śriyaṃ yaśo me dhukṣva | lokaṃ brahmavarcasamabhayaṃ yajñasamṛddhiṃ me dhukṣva, iti | iti vācayatyadhvaryumabuddhaṃ cedasya bhavati, iti | omukthaśā yaja somasyetījyāyai saṃpreṣito ye yajāmaha ityāgūrya nityayaiva yajati vyavānyevānuvaṣaṭkaroti, iti | uktaṃ vaṣaṭakārānumantraṇam, iti | āharatyadhvaryurukthapātramatigrāhyāścamasāṃśca, iti || bhakṣaṃ pratikhyāya hotā prāṅpreṅkhādavarohati, iti | athaitaṃ preṅkhaṃ pratyañcamavabadhnanti yathā śaṃsitāraṃ bhakṣayiṣyantaṃ nopahaniṣyasīti, iti | preṅkhasya hyāyatanamāsīno hotā bhakṣayati, iti | athaitadukthapātraṃ hotopasṛṣṭena japena bhakṣayati | vāgdevī somasya tṛpyatu | somo me rājā''yuḥprāṇāya varṣatu | sa me prāṇaḥ sarvamāyurduhāṃ mahat, iti | uttamādābhiplavikāttṛtīyasavanamanyadvaiśvadevānnividdhānādasya vāmasya palitasya hoturiti salilasya dairghatamasa ekacatvāriṃśatamānobhadrīyaṃ ca tasya sthāna aikāhikau vaiśvadevasya pratipadanucarau, iti | cyaveta cedyajñāyajñīyamagne tava śravo vaya iti ṣaṭstotriyānurūpau yadīlāndaṃ bhūyasīṣu cetstuvīrannā'gniṃ na svavṛktibhiriti tāvatīranurūpaḥ, iti | saṃpannaṃ mahāvrataṃ saṃtiṣṭhata idamaharagniṣṭomo yathākālamavabhṛthaṃ preṅkhaṃ hareyuḥ saṃdaheyurbṛsīḥ, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 2 ||
<5.3.3>
nādīkṣito mahāvrataṃ śaṃsennānagnau na parasmai nāsaṃvatsara ityeke kāmaṃ pitre vā''cāryāya vā śaṃsedātmano haivāsya tacchastaṃ bhavati, iti | hotṛśastreṣūkthaśā yaja somasyetyekaḥ praiṣaḥ sa nārāśaṃseṣvanārāśaṃseṣu vā hotrakāṇāmukthaśā yaja somānāmiti, iti | tadidamaharnānantevāsine prabrūyānnāsaṃvatsaravāsine no evāsaṃvatsaravāsine nābrahmacāriṇe nāsabrahmacāriṇe no evāsabrahmacāriṇe nānabhiprāptāyaitaṃ deśam, iti | na bhūyaḥ sakṛdgadanāddvirgadanādvā dvayyeva , iti| eka ekasmai prabrūyāditi ha smā''ha jātūkarṇyaḥ, iti | na vatse ca na tṛtīya iti, iti | na tiṣṭhaṃstiṣṭhate na vrajanvrajate na śayānaḥ śayānāya noparyāsīna uparyāsīnāyādha evā''sīno'dha āsīnāya, iti | nāvaṣṭabdho na pratistabdho nātivīto nāṅkaṃ kṛtvordhvajñuranapaśrito'dhīyīta na māṃsaṃ bhuktvā na lohitaṃ dṛṣṭvā na gatāsuṃ nāvratyamākramya nāktvā nābhyajya nonmardanaṃ kārayitvā na nāpitena kārayitvā na snātvā na varṇakenānulipya na srajamapinahya na striyamupagamya nollikhya nāvalikhya,iti | nedamekasminnahani samāpayediti ha smā''ha jātūkarṇyaḥ samāpayediti gālavo yadanyatprāktṛcāśītibhyaḥ samāpayedevetyāgniveśyāyano'nyamanyasmindeśe śamayamāna iti, iti | yatredamadhīyīta na tatrānyadadhīyīta yatra tvanyadadhīyīta kāmamidaṃ tatrādhīyīta, iti | nedamanadhīyantsnātako bhavati yadyapyanyadbahvadhīyānnaivedamanadhīyantsnātako bhavati, iti | no evāsmātpramādyet, iti | asmāccenna pramādyedalamātmana iti vidyāt, iti | alaṃ satyaṃ vidyāt, iti | nedaṃvidanidaṃvidā samuddiśenna sahabhuñjīta na sadhamādī syāt, iti | athātaḥ svādhyāyadharmaṃ vyākhyāsyāma upa purāṇe nā''pīte kakṣodake pūrvāhṇe na saṃbhinnāsu cchāyāsvaparāhṇe nādhyūhle meghe'partau varṣe trirātraṃ vaidikenādhyāyenāntariyānnāsminkathāṃ vadeta nāsya rātrau ca na ca kīrtayiṣet, iti | taditi vā etasya mahato bhūtasya nāma bhavati yo'syaitadevaṃ nāma veda brahma bhavati brahma bhavati, iti || ityaitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake tṛtīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 3 || iti bahavṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamāraṇyake tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
oṃ uditaḥ śukriyaṃ dadhe | tamahamātmani dadhe | anu māmaitvindriyam | mayi śrīrmayi yaśaḥ | sarvaḥ saprāṇaḥ saṃbalaḥ | uttiṣṭhāmyanu śrīḥ | uttiṣṭhatvanu mā''yantu devatāḥ | adabdhaṃ cakṣuriṣitaṃ manaḥ | sūryo jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā him̐sīḥ | taccakṣurdeva hitaṃ śukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam | tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā | tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ | āvadaṃstvaṃ śakune bhadramāvada tūṣṇīmāsīnaḥ sumatiṃ cikiddhi naḥ | yadutpatanvadasi karkuriryathā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ | śatadhāramutsamakṣīyamāṇaṃ vipaścitaṃ pitaraṃ vaktvānām | meliṃ madantaṃ pitrorupasthe taṃ rodasī pipṛtaṃ satyavācam | vāḍrame manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitamāvirāvīrma edhi vedasya ma āṇī stha śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīranenādhītena | ahorātrāntsaṃdadhāmyṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi tanmāmavatu tadvaktāramavatvavatu māmavatu vaktāramavatu vaktāram | oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ | ityuttaraśāntiḥ iti vahvṛcabrāhmaṇāraṇyakakāṇḍe pañcamamāraṇyakaṃ samāptam || 5 ||
